jobs.title: Medior Datacenter Engineer
Transit architect
jobs.description:
Als Arcadiaan help je bij het leveren van toonaangevende ontwerp-, engineering- en adviesdiensten. Je maakt deel uit van onze wereldwijde organisatie met 34.000 mensen in ruim 30 landen die zich inzetten om onze passie ‘improving quality of life’ ook echt tot leven te brengen. Iedereen speelt een belangrijke rol. Met de denkkracht van onze mensen in combinatie met technologie werken we aan het oplossen van ’s werelds meest complexe uitdagingen en maken samen het verschil.

Architectuur is overal om ons heen. De gebouwde omgeving bepaalt in grote mate de wereld waarin we leven. De architecten van Arcadis verrijken deze complexe leefomgeving met integrale en duurzame ontwerpoplossingen. Samen met onze klanten werken we aan projecten die een blijvende positieve impact hebben op huidige én toekomstige generaties.  
  
**Rolbeschrijving:**  
Als (medior) architect binnen Transit Architecture maak je deel uit van multidisciplinaire projectteams en geef je vorm aan een duurzame leefomgeving. Je werkt aan projecten door heel Nederland en mogelijk ook daarbuiten. Je weet jouw visie helder te verwoorden, te verbeelden en te vertalen naar kwalitatieve en haalbare oplossingen. Je analyseert de vraag van de klant en brengt samen met stakeholders de eisen en wensen in kaart. Vervolgens ontwikkel je samen met ervaren architecten een conceptontwerp, werk je dit technisch verder uit en breng je het visueel tot leven. Je werkt aan de renovatie en nieuwbouw van trein- en metrostations, maar ook aan uiteenlopende ontwerpopgaven zoals cultureel erfgoed, binnenstedelijke gebiedsontwikkelingen, multifunctionele gebouwen en de ruimtelijke inpassing en vormgeving van bruggen, tunnels en andere infrastructurele kunstwerken.

**Servicea area group Transit Architecture:**  
Binnen Transit Architecture bundelen we onze expertise op het gebied van trein- en metrostations. De groep bestaat uit architecten, bouwkundige ontwerpers en civieltechnische ontwerpers die samenwerken aan toonaangevende projecten in binnen- en buitenland. De afdeling telt circa 45 collega's, waaronder projectmanagers, projectbeheersers, technisch managers, contractspecialisten en ontwerpers. Het team kenmerkt zich door een sterke samenwerking, een informele sfeer en een gedeelde passie voor de gebouwde omgeving. Bij Arcadis hebben we vrijwel alle benodigde disciplines in huis. Daardoor kunnen we specialisten op het gebied van duurzaamheid, installatietechniek, landschapsarchitectuur, spoorinfrastructuur en vele andere vakgebieden direct aan projecten verbinden. Deze integrale aanpak stelt ons in staat om complexe ontwerpvraagstukken succesvol op te lossen en een breed scala aan projecten te realiseren. Amersfoort is onze thuisbasis, terwijl collega's daarnaast samenwerken vanuit de hub in Rotterdam.  
  
**Rolverantwoordelijkheden:**

* Je beheert zelfstandig (deel)projecten en zorgt ervoor dat deze worden gerealiseerd binnen de afgesproken planning, kwaliteit en financiële kaders;
* Je ontwikkelt architectonische ontwerpoplossingen en werkt deze uit in tekeningen, rapportages en andere projectdocumentatie;
* Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, projectleiders en multidisciplinaire teams om integrale en kwalitatieve oplossingen te realiseren;
* Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van ontwerpen en zorgt voor naleving van relevante wet- en regelgeving, normen en Arcadis-richtlijnen;
Je begeleidt en coacht junior collega's en draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en de ontwikkeling van het team.  

**Kwalificaties & Ervaring:**

* Afgeronde opleiding Architectuur aan een Technische Universiteit of Academie van Bouwkunst;
* Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring als architect;
* Ervaring met het begeleiden en ondersteunen van junior collega's in hun vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling;
* Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Je voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waarin ontwerp, techniek en stakeholdermanagement samenkomen. Kennis van ontwerpsoftware zoals Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp en Adobe Creative Suite is geen must maar waardevol, net als jouw inschrijving in het Architectenregister. Bij Arcadis werken we wereldwijd. Afhankelijk van je ambitie bieden we jou dan ook graag de mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan internationale projecten.  
  
**Vervolg je carrière als Arcadiaan:**  
We bereiken onze doelen door iedereen in staat te stellen het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wij geloven dat ieders bijdrage ertoe doet. Daarom pionieren we met een aanpak gebaseerd op jouw vaardigheden. Met jouw unieke ervaring en expertise stippel je zo je eigen carrièrepad uit. Samen maximaliseren we de impact! Jouw werk maakt het verschil. Waar je volgende rol bij Arcadis je ook brengt, je helpt duurzame oplossingen te bieden voor een gezondere planeet. Je drukt jouw stempel op je eigen carrière, je collega's, klanten, je leven en de wereld om je heen.  
  
**Together, we can create a lasting legacy:**  
Onze inzet voor gelijkheid, diversiteit, inclusie en erbij horen:  
We willen dat je elke dag je beste zelf kunt zijn. Gelijkheid en inclusie nemen we heel serieus en we houden onszelf verantwoordelijk voor onze acties. We willen een voorkeurswerkgever zijn en bieden iedereen een geweldige werkplek.

**Contactinformatie:**  
Wij ontvangen graag jouw CV en motivatiebrief via de Apply-button. Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact op met Femke van Viegen of TA- collega Jasper Kunstt.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Reports to an Engineering Manager · Remote (working hours within ±2 hours of CET)**

You'll own a slice of our platform outright, not just the tickets in it. Can you make the sound call, ship it, and leave the code healthier than you found it? Read on.

#### **Why this role exists**

We're growing Engineering's capacity. As the platform and team scale, we need engineers who can take a component and run with it independently — spotting risks early and raising the people around them.

#### **About C Teleport**

We move maritime, aviation, and energy crews around the world, automating high-stakes travel that used to be run by hand. We're a lean, international company: small squads, real ownership, decisions made close to the work.

#### **What you'll own**

* A component or a slice of the system, independently. Make the technical calls, keep it healthy, and know it well enough to catch problems before they become incidents.
* Production. Ship what you build and keep it running for real users, not just "done" in a ticket.
* Requirements, not just tickets. Turn a business need into a clear technical plan with Product, and flag gaps early.
* Raising the bar around you. Teach what you know, exchange feedback across the team, and document so your team isn't stuck without you.
* Your own delivery, reliably. Deliver what you commit to, and flag a slip early.
* Making the team's practices better. Improve a process, tool, or approach that no longer fits.

#### **Must-haves (these are gates)**

* You've independently owned a component or service in production — you made the calls, kept it healthy, and were accountable when something broke.
* You can turn a business requirement into a technical plan yourself, working directly with Product or another stakeholder.
* You mentor as you go; you can point to specific examples of raising another engineer's skill or judgment.
* You deliver what you commit to, and say so early when you won't.
* You're comfortable working within ±2 hours of CET, for real-time overlap with the team.
* 4+ years of hands-on .NET and C#, as your active day-to-day language.
* You actively use AI coding agents for implementation and code review. You can guide them effectively, critically assess their output, and take ownership of the resulting code.
* You apply OOD, TDD, SOLID, and CQRS deliberately; the right pattern, not just the first one.
* Strong analytical skills, proactive, and quick to pick up new concepts.

#### **Nice-to-haves (bonus, genuinely not required)**

* Experience working fully remote in a distributed team.
* A track record of landing a tool, pattern, or process change that became your team's standard.
* Experience owning a production incident end to end, including the postmortem and fix.
* Proficiency with NoSQL databases.
* Experience with message brokers (RabbitMQ or similar).
* Experience with Galileo, Amadeus, or other travel-industry APIs — a strong plus given our domain.

#### **This is not…**

* …an entry-level seat. You'll own a component early on, not a queue of pre-specified tickets.
* …a people-management role. No direct reports — your influence comes from your ownership and how much you raise the people around you.
* …the technical ceiling. The next step is Staff Software Engineer, owning a whole domain's technical direction. This is the runway to it.

#### **Remote and working hours**

Fully remote, with working hours within ±2 hours of CET/CEST for real-time overlap with the team.

#### **What you get**

* A remote-first setup, built for distributed work.
* A clear next step: Staff Software Engineer, owning a whole domain's direction.

#### **Hiring process**

* Recruiter / HR call — role, motivation, and logistics.
* Technical interview — a deep dive on how you've owned production systems, plus a technical exercise.
* Final call with the Engineering Manager you'd report to.

Target: ~2–3 weeks end to end.

#### **Pre-employment screening**

If your application is successful, we may conduct a pre-employment screening through a trusted third party, in line with applicable laws. This may include employment history, education, and other relevant publicly available information to help us understand your suitability for the role.

#### **Equal opportunity and privacy**

C Teleport is an equal-opportunity employer. We assess every application on merit and handle your data in line with GDPR.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Device Control
jobs.description:
Drive design and development of software components to control complex hardware.

#### **About Nearfield Instruments**

Nearfield Instruments (NFI) is a fast-growing scale-up high-tech company. We design, develop, integrate, market and service advanced metrology machines. Our machines enables our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers – to increase the production yields, and thus, functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics.

Founded in 2016, we bring together the most creative minds (approx. 320 employees) in science and technology and develop a one-of-a-kind, revolutionary high throughput Scanning Probe Microscopy system.

Accelerating quality testing is essential for chipmakers to meet the soaring demand for computing capabilities. To meet this need, Nearfield Instruments has developed revolutionary metrology machines. As a (Senior) Software Engineer for Device Control, you will help us write software that drives these machines. Would you like to work at the forefront of metrology innovations while rapidly growing your career? Join us and experience the direct impact that your work has on our and our clients’ performance.

#### **Who you’ll be working with**

Within our Design & Engineering department this role is part of the Software Group. This SW Group consists of 5 teams (Architectural, Machine Control, Device Control, Data Science, Integration & Support).

You will join the Device Control team consisting of software engineers with a diverse range of knowledge such as embedded software, motion control and PLC software.

#### **What you’re going to do**

* Lead a wide range of software development aspects from design to production
* Collaborate closely with other disciplines such as mechatronics and production
* Design and implement software components to control complex hardware
* Write and maintain high quality, testable and efficient code
* Support our customer support and production engineers with their software related questions
* Initiate and promote new ideas for continuous improvement of the product
* Work independently and as a team member (sometimes on a global scale)

#### **Who you are**

* Education: Masters or Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related field.
* Experience: A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in software development with a strong foundation in Design/Architecture, Software Testing, and Software Integration.
* Knowledge: Machine Vision / Computer Vision, Object recognition and Signal Processing knowledge are a plus.
* Background: Previous experience in the semiconductors industry is also a plus.

#### **Skills:**

* Coding/Design/Quality: Proficient in C#, Python, with a deep understanding of OOP Design and Unit Testing.
* Source Control and Configuration: Hands-on experience with Git, as well as familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices.
* Process and Tracking: Demonstrated experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and practical experience using Jira for project management and tracking.

#### **Apply for the job**

If the above challenges excites you, we encourage you to send us your details using the Apply now button on our career site.

**Our recruitment process:**

* Screening by Recruiter.
* Tech assignment.
* 1st interview ( Team Manager + Software Engineer).
* 2nd interview (HRBP + Director of D&E).
* Meeting our CEO.
* Offer.
* Onboarding and welcome at Nearfield Instruments!

If you have any questions? Feel free to contact me via:

#### **Recruitment, consultancy and/or other agency?**

We appreciate the interest, but we source all our candidates directly. We understand that you as an intermediary want to present candidates to our interesting positions. This is not how we have structured our recruitment.

This means that all profiles offered to Nearfield Instruments will be treated as direct applications. Unless we have explicitly agreed otherwise.

jobs.title: Software-Engineer / IT-Consultant (m/w/d) in Wetzlar
jobs.description:
**Werde Teil unseres Teams und revolutioniere die Produktionsplanung!**

Die Asprova GmbH ist die europäische Niederlassung des renommierten japanischen Softwarehauses Asprova Corp. mit Sitz in Wetzlar. Unsere Lösung ist die weltweit führende Software für Advanced Planning and Scheduling (APS) und somit das erfolgreichste Planungssystem für die produzierende Industrie. Von Wetzlar aus betreuen wir viele Kunden und Händler in Deutschland und Europa. Unter den weltweit mehr als 4.000 Kunden befinden sich viele namhafte Unternehmen.

**Wir suchen starke Persönlichkeiten, die unser Beratungs- und Implementierungsteam langfristig unterstützen. Berufsanfänger sind bei uns herzlich willkommen.**

**Deine Aufgaben nach einer ausführlichen Einarbeitungsphase:**

* **Implementierung & Beratung:** Du begleitest nationale und internationale Industrieunternehmen bei der Einführung unserer APS-Software und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Produktionsplanung effizienter, transparenter und zukunftssicher zu gestalten.
* **Customizing:** Du erstellst kundenspezifische Anwendungserweiterungen und passt die Software perfekt an.
* **Lean & Produktionsplanung:** Du baust bei uns ein fundiertes Wissen in Lean-Produktion und Lean-Management auf und lernst, wie moderne Produktions- und Planungsprozesse effizient gestaltet und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.
* **Wissensvermittlung:** Du führst Anwenderschulungen durch und unterstützt unsere Kunden bei technischen Fragen und der optimalen Nutzung von Asprova.
* **Projektleitung:** Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für nationale und internationale Softwareprojekte.
* **Prozessoptimierung:** Du entwickelst unsere Implementierungsmethoden und Projektmanagement-Tools strategisch weiter.
* **Vertriebsunterstützung:** Du stehst unserem Vertrieb bei komplexen technischen Fragestellungen beratend zur Seite.

**Das bringst Du mit:**

* **Fundierte Basis:** Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

jobs.title: New Product Introduction Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Die Rolle verantwortet die Planung und Steuerung der Industrialisierung neuer Produkte vom Prototyp bis zur Serienproduktion. Im Fokus stehen dabei die standortübergreifende Koordination von Entwicklung, Produktion und Beschaffung, inklusive Launch- und Änderungsmanagement, Ressourcen- und Investitionsplanung sowie Lean Manufacturing.

### **Aufgaben**

* Organisation der Fertigung von Prototypen (Beschaffung, Produktion, Entwicklung)
* Sicherstellen der interdisziplinären und standortübergreifenden Kommunikation zwischen den Fachabteilungen Beschaffung, Produktion und Entwicklung
* Unterstützung im Bereich des Änderungsmanagements auf Produkt- und Prozessebene
* Definition und Aufsetzen von Prozessen im Bereich der Einführung von neuen Produkten in die Serienproduktion (Launch Managements)
* Abstimmen von Schnittstellenfunktionen zwischen den Fachabteilungen Beschaffung, Produktion und Entwicklung
* Koordination der Definition von Anforderungen an Produktionsstätten
* Erstellen einer bedarfsgerechten Ressourcenplanung, Planung und Kalkulation der nötigen Investitionen für Anlagentechnik, Peripherie, Anlaufkosten sowie des operativen Personalbedarfs (Total Cost of Ownership)
* Einführung von neuen Produkten in nationalen und internationalen Produktionsstätten
* Aufsetzten, Aktualisieren und Sicherstellen von Projektplänen und Projektzielen
* Einhaltung von Prinzipien Lean Manufacturing und Design to Manufacturing

### **Qualifikationen**

* Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches oder kaufmännisches Studium oder vergleichbare Ausbildung (z.B. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Vergleichbares)
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement
* Ausgeprägtes strategisches Denken
* Tiefgreifendes technisches und wirtschaftliches Verständnis
* Fähigkeit, komplexe Situationen zu kontrollieren, den Fokus nicht zu verlieren und eine zielgerichtete Prioritätensetzung durchzuführen
* Hohes Kosten- und Qualitätsbewusstsein und lösungsorientiertes Denken
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
* Strukturierte Arbeitsweise im Team sowie eigenverantwortlich
* Hands-on Mentalität und Flexibilität
* Reisebereitschaft national und international
* Selbständige, dynamische Arbeitsweise, Verhandlungsgeschick, Durchsetzungsvermögen und Belastbarkeit
* Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

### **What we offer**

* A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
* Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
* Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
* Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
* Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
* Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

### **About us**

**Agile Robots SE** is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than **3500** employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

jobs.title: (Senior) Full Stack Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) – B2B-Webshop
jobs.description:
**Spannend, aufstrebend und verdammt schnell – wir sind flaschenpost!**

Wir liefern den Wocheneinkauf innerhalb von 120 Minuten zu unseren Kund:innen.

Gemeinsam mit über 20.000 Kolleg:innen schaffen wir es, eine komplette Branche neu zu erfinden. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2016 sind wir mittlerweile als Sofortlieferdienst für Getränke und Lebensmittel in nahezu allen Metropolregionen Deutschlands vertreten.

Seit 2020 ist die flaschenpost Teil der Oetker-Gruppe.

### **(Senior)****Full****Stack Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) – B2B-Webshop**

Um unsere Mission zu erfüllen, suchen wir für unseren **B2B-Webshop** zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen **Fullstack****Software Entwickler (m/w/d)**. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem neuen Team den B2B-Webshop weiter und trägst zum Wachstum unseres B2B-Kundenbereichs bei.

### **Dein Liefergebiet:**

* Du entwickelst neue Features für unseren B2B-Webshop – von der Idee über die Architektur bis zum Go-Live.

* Du arbeitest entlang der gesamten Customer Journey unserer B2B-Kund:innen – von Registrierung und Produktentdeckung über Warenkorb und Checkout bis hin zu Self-Service-Funktionalitäten.

* Du übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Entscheidungen, sorgst für eine saubere Architektur und treibst technische Exzellenz im Team voran.

* Du unterstützt bei der Anbindung von neuen Business Kunden über ERP-Systeme.

* Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen, um fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.

* Du unterstützt deine Kolleg:innen als Sparringspartner:in, z.B. bei Code-Reviews, Pair Programming und bei der Weiterentwicklung der Team-Standards.

* Tech-Stack: .NET 8, Entity-Framework, Blazor

### **Das hast du im Sortiment:**

*Die folgenden Qualifikationen stellen lediglich eine Orientierung dar. Du erkennst dich in den Punkten wieder oder hast Lust, dich in diese einzuarbeiten? Gerne geben wir auch**Quereinsteiger:innen**mit IT-Begeisterung und Motivation die Chance bei uns einzusteigen!*

* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Fullstack-Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in E‑Commerce- oder B2B-Webapplikationen.

* Du besitzt gute Kenntnisse in der Frontend-Entwicklung, vorzugsweise Blazor, und bist motiviert, deine eigenen Ideen in das Design des B2B-Webshops einzubringen und umzusetzen.

* Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Datenbanken, idealerweise MS-SQL und Entity Framework

* Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur, Clean Code, Testing und wartbare, skalierbare Systeme.

* Du arbeitest gerne cross-funktional in einem agilen Umfeld (Scrum/Kanban) und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Teamkultur ein.

* Du kommunizierst klar und wertschätzend – auf Deutsch fühlst du dich sicher, Englisch ist für dich in technischen Kontexten kein Problem.

### **Die Top-Angebote der flaschenpost:**

* **Work-Life Balance**– Gestalte deinen Arbeitstag flexibel nach deinen Vorstellungen und genieße die Freiheit des mobilen Arbeitens

* **Job-Ticket & Business-Bike** – Damit nicht nur die Arbeitszeit flexibel ist

* **Start-Up-Features**– Genieße Freigetränke und die ein oder andere Partie Kicker oder Tischtennis als Ausgleich zur Arbeit

* **Flaschenpost Learning** – Erstelle deine persönliche Learning Journey und erweitere dein Know-how durch vielfältige und innovative Trainings

* **Buddy Programm** – Dein flaschenpost-Buddy steht dir während der Einarbeitung mit Rat und Tat zur Seite

* **Modernste Technik** – Wir legen großen Wert auf Fortschritt und Innovation

* **Team- und Networking-Events**– Halte dich fit und lerne deine Kolleg:innen beim Betriebssport, Spieleabend und Stammtisch besser kennen

* **Corporate Benefits** – Profitiere von Rabatten und Angeboten in Online-Shops und Fitnessstudios

* **Social****Responsiveness** – Blutspenden während der Arbeitszeit und damit Leben retten

Wir haben dich überzeugt und du möchtest unseren Erfolg aktiv mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über unser Onlineformular.

jobs.title: Cooling Flow System and Clearance Design Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
**Momentaufnahme von Ihrem Tag**

Als Cooling Flow System and Clearance Design Engineer (w/m/d) arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen Team von Ingenieuren an Projekten zur Entwicklung von Service-Upgrades und neuen Produkten sowie zur Unterstützung unserer Serviceorganisation. Typischerweise arbeiten Sie zusammen mit Projektmanagern, Komponenten-Ingenieuren und Kollegen aus Produktion und Service.  
Sie bearbeiten Ihre individuellen Aufgaben eigenständig und stimmen die Prioritäten gemeinsam innerhalb eines globalen Teams ab.

**Wie Sie etwas bewirken können**

  

* Anwendung von interner und kommerzieller Berechnungssoftware für:
* + Erstellung von Berechnungsmodellen zur Beschreibung der Kühlluftversorgung von Heißgaskomponenten in einer Gasturbine und Auswertung der entsprechenden Ergebnisse
  + Erstellung von Berechnungsmodellen zur Beschreibung der transienten Erwärmung und thermischen Ausdehnung der gesamten Gasturbine sowie Bestimmung optimaler Montage-Spalte zwischen rotierenden und stationären Komponenten
  + Auswertung der Modellergebnisse und Ableitung von konstruktionsrelevanten Schlussfolgerungen
* Mitarbeit bei der konzeptionellen Entwicklung des Sekundärluftsystems und zugehöriger Gasturbinenkomponenten
* Auswertung von Betriebsdaten und Erkenntnissen aus Prototypen und der bestehenden Flotte

**Was Sie mitbringen**

* Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Maschinenbau oder vergleichbar; Promotion von Vorteil
* Langjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Wärmeübertragung und Strömungsmechanik sowie idealerweise mit Kühlluftsystemen und Spaltkonstruktion für Gasturbinen
* Gute technische Kenntnisse im Maschinenbau oder in der Energietechnik, idealerweise in der Entwicklung, Auslegung und Integration komplexer technischer Systeme
* Kenntnisse in der Anwendung numerischer Software (z. B. Ansys, Abaqus, NX, StarCCM etc.) wie von Programmiersprachen (Visual Basic, C#, Fortran, Python) sind von Vorteil
* Kenntnisse in Machine Learning, datengetriebenen Methoden und deren Anwendung auf technische bzw. physikalische Fragestellungen sind von Vorteil
* Interkulturelle Arbeitserfahrung in globalen Teams ist ebenso von Vorteil wie gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

**Über das Team**

Unser Geschäftsbereich Gas Services bietet emissionsarme Stromerzeugung durch Service und Dekarbonisierung. Emissionsfreie oder emissionsarme Stromerzeugung und alle Gasturbinen unter einem Dach, Dampfturbinen und Generatoren. Dekarbonisierungschancen durch Serviceangebote, Modernisierung und Digitalisierung der Flotte.

**Wer ist Siemens Energy?**  
  
Wir bei Siemens Energy sind mehr als nur ein Energietechnologieunternehmen. Mit ~100,000 engagierten Mitarbeitern in mehr als 90 Ländern entwickeln wir die Energiesysteme der Zukunft und stellen sicher, dass der wachsende Energiebedarf der Weltgemeinschaft zuverlässig und nachhaltig gedeckt wird. Die in unseren Forschungsabteilungen und Fabriken entstehenden Technologien treiben die Energiewende voran und bilden die Grundlage für ein Sechstel der weltweiten Stromerzeugung.
  
  
Unser globales Team setzt sich dafür ein, nachhaltige, zuverlässige und bezahlbare Energie Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen, indem es die Grenzen des Möglichen immer weiter hinausschiebt. Wir blicken zurück auf eine 150-jährige Tradition der Innovation, die unsere Suche nach Mitarbeitern bestärkt, die unseren Fokus auf Dekarbonisierung, neue Technologien und Energiewandel unterstützen.
  
  
Hier erfahren Sie, wie Sie bei Siemens Energy etwas bewirken können: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

**Unser Engagement für Vielfalt**  
  
Gut, dass wir nicht alle gleich sind. Vielfalt macht uns leistungsstark. Wir leben von Inklusion und unsere gemeinsame kreative Energie wird von über 130 Nationalitäten gespeist. Siemens Energy setzt auf den Charakter - unabhängig von ethnischem Hintergrund, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion, Identität oder Behinderung. Wir versorgen die Gesellschaft mit Energie - die ganze Gesellschaft - und wir diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von Unterschieden, die zwischen uns bestehen.  
  
**Benefits**

* Neben einem attraktiven, marktgerechten Vergütungspaket erwartet Sie eine attraktive arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersversorgung
* Daneben bieten wir die Möglichkeit, zu sehr interessanten Mitarbeiterkonditionen Aktionär\*in von Siemens Energy zu werden
* Unter unserem Motto #BetterTogether bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, flexibel und auch remote zu arbeiten. Aber auch unsere Büros lassen keine Wünsche offen und bieten Raum für inspirierende Zusammenarbeit und Kreativität
* Die berufliche und auch persönliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden ist uns ein großes Anliegen. Sie haben bei uns die Möglichkeit selbstbestimmt zu lernen und sich zu entwickeln. Dafür stehen unterschiedliche attraktive Programme und Maßnahmen zur Verfügung
Unter dem Aspekt "Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf" haben wir ein vielfältiges Angebot, z.B. flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Kinderbetreuungsplätze an vielen Standorten, die Möglichkeit zur Schnupperteilzeit oder auch ein Sabbatical  

Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit, deswegen sind Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung ausdrücklich gewollt.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer C++/C#/.NET (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Diese Rolle ist nichts für Bewerber, die genaue Specs brauchen, bevor sie anfangen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n engagierten

**Senior Software Developer C++/C#/.NET (m/w/d)**
-------------------------------------------------

Standort: Remote | Vollzeit

Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für definierte Komponenten unseres Server Backends im Bereich Cyber Security und E-Mail-Management. C++ und C# sind das Werkzeug, nicht das Ziel. Das Ziel sind Module, die stabil laufen – auch wenn niemand zuschaut.

**Ihre Rolle bei uns**
----------------------

* Sie entwerfen und implementieren komplexe Backend-Module auf Basis von C++ und .NET. Innerhalb der Architekturvorgaben treffen Sie Entscheidungen selbst. Wenn die Vorgaben nicht passen, sagen Sie das – mit Begründung, nicht mit Bauchgefühl.
* Sie verantworten Stabilität und Performance der Module in Ihrem Bereich. Verantwortung heißt hier konkret: Sie kennen die relevanten KPIs – Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, MTTR, Defect Rate – und Sie handeln, wenn die Zahlen kippen. Bevor jemand fragt.
* Sie führen Code Reviews mit Substanz. Reviews sind keine Korrekturmaschine, sondern der Punkt, an dem Qualität entsteht – oder eben nicht. Sie machen technische Schulden in Ihrem Bereich sichtbar, mit Aufwand und Konsequenz, und treiben deren Abbau aktiv.
* Sie begleiten Junior- und Mid-Level-Entwickler durch Pairing, Reviews und direktes Feedback. Senior heißt: Das Team wird durch Sie besser. Nicht laut. Aber messbar.
* NFRs – Performance, Security, Reliability – sind Teil jeder Implementierungsentscheidung, nicht der Punkt, an dem nachträglich repariert wird.
* **Entscheidungen, die in dieser Rolle bei Ihnen liegen**
* Implementierungsansatz und technische Umsetzung innerhalb der Architekturvorgaben. Auswahl von Libraries und Tools ohne systemweite Auswirkung. Struktur und Organisation des Codes in Ihrem Bereich. Sie können Merges blockieren, die definierte Standards verletzen – und das wird von Ihnen erwartet, nicht nur geduldet.
* Systemweite Architekturentscheidungen treffen Sie nicht allein. Aber Sie beeinflussen sie – mit Substanz, nicht mit Meinung.
* **Was diese Rolle nicht ist**
* Kein Senior-by-Tenure. Wer fünf Jahre dabei ist, ohne sichtbare Wirkung auf Code, Team oder System, wird hier nicht glücklich. Wer Code Reviews als persönlichen Angriff empfindet, ebenfalls nicht. Wer ohne genaue Specs nicht weiterweiß, sollte sich auf eine Mid-Level-Stelle bewerben – das ist keine Wertung, sondern eine ehrliche Einschätzung der Erwartung.

**Was Sie mitbringen sollten**
------------------------------

* Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung mit C++ und im .NET-Ökosystem (C#, .NET, .NET Core). Belastbar in Microservices, Multi-Threading, REST, Service Bus, ASP.NET, SQL.
* Erfahrung mit E-Mail-Infrastrukturen wie Microsoft SMTP und Exchange sowie mit Azure ist ein deutlicher Vorteil, ebenso solide Kenntnisse in Windows Server und Linux.
* Visual Studio kennen Sie wie Ihre Werkzeugkiste.
* Deutsch und Englisch auf Arbeitsniveau.
* Scrum aus der Praxis, nicht aus dem Buch.
* Worauf wir im Gespräch zurückkommen werden – und was Sie auf Beispiele zurückführen können sollten: Sie haben Refactoring- oder Tech-Debt-Initiativen aktiv getrieben, nicht nur erlitten. Sie haben mindestens einen Junior so weit begleitet, dass er selbstständig arbeitet. Sie haben einen Code Review schon einmal mit Substanz abgelehnt – und können den Grund in zwei Sätzen sagen. Sie können erklären, woran Sie erkennen, dass ein System unter Last bricht, bevor es bricht.

**Was Sie bei uns erwartet**
----------------------------

* Ein strukturiertes Onboarding und Mentoring durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen.
* Ein innovatives Produktportfolio mit Fokus auf E-Mail-Sicherheit, Compliance und KI.
* Plattformunabhängige Lösungen, die echten Wettbewerbsvorteil bieten.
* Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und echte Karriereperspektiven.

**Warum GBS?**
--------------

* Unsere Lösungen sind „Made in Germany“ – und das ist wieder gefragt.
* Wir wachsen stark und investieren in Technologie, Talent und Zukunft.
* Sie arbeiten mit Kund:innen, die wirklich etwas bewegen – und Sie bewegen mit.

**Darüber hinaus profitieren Sie von**
--------------------------------------

Bei GBS erwartet Sie ein Arbeitgeber mit flachen Hierarchien, der Ihre persönliche Entwicklung, Stärken und Wachstumspotenziale identifiziert und fördert. Wir stehen als Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit, indem wir es jeder Person ermöglichen, ihr wahres Selbst zu zeigen. Uns ist es wichtig, das unsere Mitarbeiter ihre persönlichen Anforderungen und die familiären Verpflichtungen mit der Arbeit vereinbaren können. Wir bieten Ihnen daher flexible Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitmodelle und die Option, im Büro, mobil oder hybrid zu arbeiten. Und natürlich 30 Urlaubstage für Ihre Erholung.

jobs.title: 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern - Germany
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Please note the role is available across multiple locations in Germany.  
  
Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
  
  
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
  
  
Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  
  
At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
  
  
We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
  
  
Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
  
  
Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation.
  
  
Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team.
  
  
Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.
  
  
Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
  
  
Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.
  
  
Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
  
  
Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.
  
  
Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
  
  
A day in the life  
As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  
  
In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.
  
  
About the team  
Intern Community:  
  
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.  
  
Support:  
  
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.  
  
Learning Sessions:  
  
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.  
  
Opportunities:  
  
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related STEM fields
* Experience with at least one general-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C++, C#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience from previous technical internship(s) or demonstrated project experience
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Strong problem decomposition, problem-solving, and analytical skills
* Demonstrated ownership and initiative in seeing work through from design to operation
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
m/w/d  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Progressive Building Society is a leading local financial institution with a proud reputation for customer service excellence. Our purpose is to encourage local people to save and become homeowners, through our personal, caring & common-sense approach, essentially nurturing financial well being for current and future generations.

The Society is continuing to modernise and improve through its operational resilience processes, strong customer experience including self-services capabilities, integration between platforms, automation of processes, supporting our community and caring about our environmental impact.

**What you will be doing**

Developing, supporting and continuously improving software solutions that enhance the Society’s systems and business processes, working under supervision as part of the IT team and in line with Progressive’s development standards, security controls and regulatory requirements.

The role contributes to the Society’s strategic plan by analysing requirements, building and integrating applications, and promoting best practices such as CI/CD and test-driven development to improve user experience, automation and operational efficiency.

**About The Role**

**The Software Developer will be required to:**

* Analyse business needs with stakeholders to gather requirements for new and existing projects.
* Work with the in-house subject matter experts and IT teams to support the business and improve automation of key processes.
* Develop and maintain .NET solutions (e.g., C#, ASP.NET Core, APIs and background services) or SaaS platform changes, in line with agreed architecture and the Society’s coding standards and to deliver improved customer experience.
* Implement best practices such as continuous integration, continuous delivery and test-driven development.
* Write and maintain automated tests (unit/integration) using appropriate .NET testing frameworks and support test execution within the CI pipeline.
* Use source control and follow branching, pull request and code review practices; address review feedback and share learning with the team.
* Support data-related development including SQL query writing, stored procedure changes where applicable, and safe use of ORM/data access patterns.
* Assist with troubleshooting and resolution of defects and incidents across development, test and production environments, under supervision, including root-cause analysis and fix validation.
* Produce clear technical documentation (e.g., configuration notes, support guides and release notes) to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.
* Support build and release processes for .NET applications (e.g., Azure DevOps pipelines), including deployment steps, environment configuration and post-release verification.
* Use AI-assisted development tools appropriately to support software design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge discovery, while applying professional judgement, security requirements and coding standards.
* Evaluate and validate outputs generated by AI tools to ensure accuracy, maintainability, security and compliance with the Society's policies and regulatory obligations.
* Contribute to the adoption of emerging development practices, including responsible use of AI technologies to improve team productivity and software quality.

  *Progressive Building Society is committed to providing equal opportunities for all. As part of our recruitment process, successful applicants will be subject to our pre-employment checks. These include credit checks and criminal record checks (Access NI basic check through a responsible body).*

**Required Criteria**

* Degree in Computer Science related discipline.
* A minimum of one year’s experience developing applications in a professional work environment.
* Experience of .NET ecosystem and C#.
* Awareness of programming best practices and ability to apply them under guidance
* Good understanding of current and emerging technologies and their potential to deliver business benefits.
* Good analytical approach to problem solving.
* API integration to core platforms (e.g. banking systems).
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to adapt style and explanations to support others’ understanding.
* Understanding of AI-assisted software development tools and the ability to apply them effectively to support coding, testing, debugging, documentation and problem solving.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure solutions meet security, quality and business requirements.

**Desired Criteria**

* A scripting language, such as Python or Powershell.
* Development and design skills with MS SQL or Oracle.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or similar technologies.

**About The Company**

Careers at Progressive

We know that looking for a career means so much more than just finding a job. At Progressive, we want to help you find your happy place to work.

We firmly believe in encouraging our employees to achieve the right balance between their work and personal lives, delivering access to and promoting family-friendly policies.

This not only increases employee satisfaction but also enables Progressive to meet the needs of our Members and supports the Society in being positioned as one of the most successful financial institutions in Northern Ireland.

**Company Culture**

To work for Progressive is to be part of something special. We strive to nurture and develop our employees in the evolving and fast paced financial services industry. Outlined below are a list of the reasons why we feel Progressive is a great place to work:

We aim to provide an inclusive and respectful working environment, where everyone recognises the importance and impact of teamwork.

We celebrate staff diversity and work hard to ensure that our staff members feel valued as individuals and respected for their contribution to our success.

We offer opportunities for our staff to work at the heart of our communities and make real differences to our Members’ lives.

We do not subscribe to a long-hours culture, instead valuing family life and supporting our staff to balance work and family commitments.

**Company Benefits**

We offer our staff competitive employment conditions and a range of benefits designed to achieve high levels of staff engagement and job satisfaction.

We understand that by taking steps to positively enhance the well-being of our staff, we can help them to achieve their goals and boost their motivation to deliver the best possible outcomes for our members.

Vacation, Paid time off, Performance bonuses, Paid sick days, Retirement plan and/or pension, Employee development programs, Tuition reimbursement, Open office, Competitive salary, Life insurance, Long service recognition, Employee Assistance Scheme, Wellbeing Scheme, Work With Charities, Social Opportunities, Annual Rise

**Salary**

Not disclosed

jobs.title: Senior Principal Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Today, Assystem is among the top three independent nuclear engineering firms worldwide. With over 60 years of experience in highly regulated sectors, the group supports public and industrial stakeholders in the execution of complex and strategic infrastructure projects, subject to high safety and security requirements.

Assystem mobilizes 8,000 experts in 13 countries and intervenes across the entire project lifecycle, in engineering, project management and digital solutions.

 **Job Description**

**Join the Fusion and Modular Nuclear Business Unit!** Assystem has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Principal MechanicalEngineer to join our expanding Fusion and Modular Nuclear (FMN) business unit. As leaders in the design and development of new technologies, you will have the opportunity to work across multiple cutting-edge projectsdeveloping technical solutions making net-zero power generation a reality.

**Your mission:**

* Lead and support the development of designs for the following systems:
* Personnel Airlocks, Main Equipment Access Hatch, Fuel Transfer Channel, Piping Penetrations, Electrical Penetrations, Specialist Nuclear Doors
* Conduct DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) to identify and mitigate potential failure modes early in the design process.
* Perform HAZID (Hazard Identification Study) to assess and document risks across the system.
* Complete and maintain Human Factors Checklists to ensure ergonomics and usability are considered in design decisions.
* Update and manage the project’s Risk Register to track, evaluate, and mitigate emerging risks.
* Design Package Production in Line with Requirements – Oversee the creation of comprehensive design packages, ensuring alignment with project specifications, technical standards, and operational needs.
* Management of Interfaces – Coordinate effectively between engineering teams, suppliers, and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of cooling water systems with other reactor components.
* Preparation of Technical Specifications – Develop clear, detailed technical specifications to guide procurement, fabrication, and installation of key cooling water system components.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including both new and existing FTEs and secondees across engineering and project functions.

**Why Join the Community of Switchers?**

* Over 55 years in nuclear engineering.
* Ranked among the top 3 largest nuclear engineering companies.
* Attractive social benefits, including an engaging Employee Committee and holiday bonuses.
* Ongoing training with numerous career opportunities.
* 70% of our managers are promoted internally!
* Hybrid work: 1-2 days remote per week.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Multi-Disciplinary Team Leadership – Skilled in managing and coordinating diverse engineering teams.
* Steam Cycle Modelling Oversight – Ability to define modelling outcomes and ensure accurate implementation.
* Project Budget & Lifecycle Planning – Experienced in budgeting and planning for full design lifecycles.
* Cooling Water Equipment Expertise – Strong track record in designing and optimizing cooling water systems.
* Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge – Well-versed in ONR, Environment Agency, and HSE regulations.
* Requirements Capture Experience – Skilled in gathering and defining technical requirements.
* Systems Engineering Awareness – Strong understanding of integrated design principles.
* Subcontractor Management – Experienced in overseeing and coordinating subcontractors.
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) – Professional accreditation in a relevant discipline.
* Security Clearance Eligibility – Capable of obtaining SC clearance for secure projects.

  
**Additional Information**  

* Excellent communication skills, written and oral
* Strong leadership skills
* Focus on delivering quality output to time and budget
* Act with integrity and instils this in others
* Has an appreciation of wider technical issues beyond own discipline – Understands interdisciplinary challenges and their impact on projects.
* Ability to work with a high degree of independence, using their own initiative and self-motivation – Proactive and capable of managing tasks autonomously.
* Confident in a multi-party, multi-national environment – Comfortable working with global teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to travel to Assystem offices and customer sites within the UK
* To undertake work packages supporting major UK and international Nuclear Clients – Contributes to high-profile nuclear projects with global impact.

**Due to the nature of work to be undertaken applicants will be required to meet certain residency criteria in order to attain a minimum level of UK security clearance if not already security cleared to a minimum SC level.**

**NOTICE TO CANDIDATES ON RECRUITMENT FRAUD - We are committed to safeguarding candidates from fraudulent activity associated with our recruitment process. Please note that we will never offer specialist CV writing services, request payment or ask for sensitive personal information during the recruitment process.**

We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Watt Laser**

Watt Laser designs and builds high-performance laser systems. Our machines combine precision optics, motion control, electronics, and the software that drives them is at the heart of every product we ship. Our products span multiple industries including electronics and automotive.

**The Position**

We are looking for a university graduate to join our engineering team. You will work alongside experienced engineers writing the software that controls our laser machines and the systems around them, from low-level hardware control to the interfaces operators use every day.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility. The code you write will run on machines we sell to customers, and you will see your work go from idea to operating hardware.

What you’ll do

* Develop and test software that controls laser machines, motion stages and related hardware.
* Work with control systems reading from sensors, driving actuators and keeping processes running reliably and safely.
* Build and improve tools, interfaces and dashboards used to operate, monitor and calibrate our machines.
* Help diagnose and fix issues across software, electronics and hardware, often working hands-on.
* Contribute to design discussions, code reviews and documentation as a full member of the team.

**What we’re looking for**

* Attained a degree in Software/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Mechatronics or a related subject.
* Solid programming fundamentals – experience with C# or similar language.
* An interest in how software meets the physical world: control systems, hardware, electronics or robotics.
* A practical, methodical approach to problem-solving and a willingness to get hands-on in the lab.
* Good communication skills and the enthusiasm to learn quickly in a small, collaborative team.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to embedded systems, microcontrollers or real-time programming.
* Experience with motion control, instrumentation, signal processing or test automation.
* Any personal, academic or hobby projects involving hardware or control.

**What you’ll get**

* A genuine engineering role with mentoring, ownership of real projects and a clear view of how a product is built end to end.
* Experience across the full stack of a physical product – software, control, electronics and optics.
* A competitive salary.

**Location: Glasgow - On Site**

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Glasgow G73: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (preferred)

Application question(s):

* Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?

Education:

* Bachelor's (preferred)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Full Stack Engineer to grow their career at AJ Bell, helping us to develop the future of our services that power Feel Good Investing. You will be joining a cross functional development team which has a philosophy of continuous improvement, and a strong focus on engineering excellence.

This role is part of a growing team focussed on providing the core services that underpin our apps and websites, ensuring our customers are provided with world-class innovative investment solutions and services.

We are on the lookout for an experienced Full Stack Engineer who can help architect, build and deploy apis, web apps, data layers, and 3rd party integrations across the stack, from NodeJS (Typescript), MongoDB, React, and cloud-native solutions in AWS.

**What to expect:**

* Hands-on with full stack feature development, working with other engineers across different disciplines in a dedicated product-aligned squad
* A dynamic, cross-functional Agile squad with a continuous improvement mindset, and autonomy to do the right thing
* Working closely with Product, UX and Business colleagues, as well as mobile and web engineers, to propose new solutions and pilot ideas that help customers Feel Good Investing
* Embrace a ‘build it, run it, own it’ DevOps mentality, nurturing code from idea all the way to production

**Tech Competency**

* 5+ years commercial experience developing web applications and APIs with some of the following; Node (Typescript), React, PHP, .NET core, MongoDB and/or SQL.
* Experience in developing HTTP-based APIs and implementation of RESTful services, as well as GraphQL
* Thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines with experience of Jenkins and/or CodePipeline
* Practices Test Driven Development and is comfortable with various test frameworks and concepts.
* Familiarisation with containerisation and tools like Docker, ECS or Kubernetes
* Experience of developing, deploying, and maintaining Cloud-Based solutions on AWS
* Strong technical background in web development with Javascript frameworks would be ideal
* Understand the principles behind what makes a high performing web page

**Other required skills:**

* Demonstrable experience working with stakeholders from product management and other business areas to design and deliver a solution
* An interest in user experience and an appreciation for helping to solve the problem customers have
* A keen eye for detail and ability to articulate and digest technical and non-technical requirements to others

AJ Bell is one of the UK’s fastest-growing investment platform businesses, providing award-winning solutions for everyone, from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

We’re proud to be recognised as one of the UK’s Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work® in 2025 and 2026 a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

* 25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
* 6% Pension with matched contributions
* Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)
* Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
* Free onsite gym
* Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
* Travel and bike loan schemes Employee Assistance Programme

**Life at AJ Bell**

* Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
* Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
* Casual dress code
* Friendly, supportive team environment

We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.

jobs.title: AI & Software Development Apprentice
jobs.description:
**Hands-On AI & Software Development Apprentice**

**Full-time apprenticeship | Northampton | On site**

**Cybist has an exceptional opportunity for a bright, creative and ambitious aspiring software developer to take steps towards turning a passion for AI into a career, in a real world practical environment helping build intelligent applications and integrations that make a real difference to a growing business.**

**About Cybist**

We are a rapidly growing **eco tech business**, giving high-quality computers and IT equipment a second life, reducing electronic waste and making technology more accessible. Visit cybist.com or visit our Amazon webstore.

Our small, friendly, professional team has big ambitions. We are rapidly integrating AI into our software and business systems, developing tools for product identification, listing creation, app integration and commercial decision-making.

Our commitment to creating opportunities for young people has been recognised with a Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) Kickstart award. We are also engaging with Amazon’s US team on advanced listing and multichannel selling tools, contributing practical feedback from our own development and commercial experience.

You will learn how AI and software can support our work streams - and you will be hands-on and carry out work with the hardware itself, equipment and processes.

As your skills develop, the role can evolve around your strengths, interests and the needs of the business.

**What you will work on**

* Building and testing AI-assisted applications for real business use.
* Connecting apps and services through APIs and tools such as Zapier, Make and n8n.
* Developing software that supports product listings, ecommerce and our internal operational systems.
* Supporting practical production and stock workflows, using our mobile app to capture product information and photographs, and helping organise equipment in the correct stock areas.
* Working with code, databases and AI tools to solve practical problems.
* Exploring new ideas and helping turn the best ones into reliable, useful applications.

**Who we are looking for**

Someone with a fantastic enthusiasm for AI and software, strong technical curiosity and an ability to solve problems and the determination to work things out. Someone not afraid to work hard and to put in what it takes to achieve success.

You should already be experimenting with coding, AI tools or automation. Personal projects, college work, a useful script, an app integration or something you have built for fun can all demonstrate your potential.

Familiarity with coding would be useful, whether in Python, JavaScript or another language. We also value creativity, clear thinking, attention to detail and the ability to work well with others. Our current system being developed is PostgressSQL/.NET/React and Tailwind using ChatGPT Pro/Codex.

**What you will gain**

* Structured apprenticeship training, a recognised qualification and paid time for learning.
* Practical support and mentoring within a small team.
* Experience developing software and AI integrations used in a real business.
* The chance to contribute ideas and take increasing responsibility as your skills grow.
* A foundation for a career in software development, AI and automation.

**How to apply**

To help your application stand out, please send your CV with a short cover letter explaining:

* Why this opportunity interests you.
* Why you think you would be especially good at it, including examples of anything you have built or explored.
* When you would be available to come in, meet the team and attend an interview.

Links to projects, GitHub repositories, screenshots or a short demonstration are welcome. Tell us what you personally contributed and what you learned.

**If you have the curiosity to explore, the creativity to build and the ambition to keep improving, we would like to hear from you.**

Pay: £15,000.00-£18,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Free parking
* On-site parking

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Architect Engineer - Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
At Amentum, we're not just solving problems; we're engineering the future. Our team is driven by an unyielding commitment to innovation, integrity, and collaboration, tackling some of the most significant challenges in science, security, and sustainability. If you're passionate about making a real impact and want to be part of a community that values ethical excellence, this is the place where your ambition can thrive.

Here, we believe that success comes from continuously pushing boundaries and working together to deliver on our promises. We embrace challenges with confidence and are dedicated to creating a secure and vibrant future for all.

We’ll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.

People are our greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent.

In addition to the benefits you’d expect, UK employees also receive free single medical cover and digital GP service, family-friendly benefits such as enhanced parental leave pay and free membership of employee assistance and parental programmes, plus reimbursement towards relevant professional development and memberships.

**Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area** for us. We’re happy to discuss **hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours**, patterns and locations to suit you and our business.

**About the Opportunity**

Amentum is currently recruiting for an Architect Engineer - Engineering Manager to join our Engineering & Technical Services (ETS) business. ETS is entering an exciting phase of opportunity by supporting our key client’s UK nuclear fleet through a business transformation, and by supporting new small modular reactor developers. Our work is varied, covering New Build, Generation, Life Extension, and Defueling, and our capabilities are in demand across the nuclear secto**r.**

**Are you good at spinning plates?**

It’s not something you see very often on TV these days, but figuratively, it is a very useful skill, one which is vital if your goal is to keep nuclear power stations operating safely, contributing to the UK’s Net Zero carbon target, or to help prepare them for decommissioning.

  

The UK’s five operating stations deliver 16% of the UK’s power, and it takes a large team delivering 100’s of projects to enable these stations to continue generating as well as defuel the three stations that have ceased operation - and that’s a lot of plates.

  

**And this is where you come in**

Your role will be to co-ordinate multi-disciplinary engineering teams and activities, delivering complex engineering solutions to time, cost and quality on projects of varying sizes. If you’re familiar with project delivery, you’ll know that they have plenty of moving parts and complexity, which is why you’ll be working alongside our Operations Managers and Framework Directors to support you to deliver successful outcomes for clients.

  

**People are at the heart of everything we do**

Centre to the success of the role will be your people skills, building effective relationships and interacting with multiple internal and external stakeholders in multiple locations.

  

You’ll also work closely with colleagues to support activities that offer the best service to the client. Through your interactions, you’ll be able to gather useful intelligence on client needs and work with the team to deliver innovative solutions.

  

You’ll utilise your strong communication and engagement skills to achieve client, people and business outcomes, working with your team and peers that are based in different locations across the UK.

  

We’re continuously evolving and growing the business, so there’s plenty of opportunity to evolve and grow your skills and career too.

  

This role will be based at one of our offices (Leiston or London). We put flexibility at the heart of what we do and we’re happy to consider flexible working patterns. Key responsibilities will be:

  

* Co-ordinate multi-discipline engineering teams to deliver complex engineering solutions to time, cost and quality on projects of varying sizes
* Marshall projects through an investment delivery process, from FEED to solution delivery
* Act as Architect Engineer on projects, taking ownership of technical challenges, developing strategies, and managing stakeholders and interfaces in order to implement technical solutions
* Development and delivery of clear engineering strategies
* Manage significant number of varied stakeholders
* Deliver projects across a typical project lifecycle, including bidding, definition of requirements, design and implementation, into delivery of commissioned systems ready to support the needs of our clients
* Safety Case Alignment: Liaison with Case Officers to ensure safety case strategy is integrated with design development. Support for development of safety case documentation
* Identify and manage technical risks
* Support the Project Manager with respect to resourcing and financial elements, such as costs and schedule, and supporting change control and identification and control of technical risks

**Qualifications, Skills & Experience**

  

* Degree qualified or equivalent (e.g. HNC/HND with significant experience) in engineering discipline with extensive design experience
* Chartered Engineer, Fellow or similar demonstrable experience
* A Mechanical, Process, EC&I, Structural Integrity or Civils technical background is essential
* Self-starter with a professional leadership approach and a technical background
* Nuclear industry, and/or equivalent safety case, experience
* Demonstrable experience in leading and managing multidiscipline teams
* Proven experience of engineering delivery within a nuclear or highly regulated environment
* Motivated team member with the ability to work to deadlines and communicate project progress
* Good communication skills and ability to articulate information to a broad range of stakeholders
* Ability to produce a project strategy to solve technical problems and take ownership of all the interfaces to implement the solution
* Experience of executing project tasks against relevant codes, standards, and best practices
* Knowledge of Project Management principles and experience of handling change control and making informed judgements to control or mitigate project risks
* Committed to Continuous Professional Development of self and others
* Previous experience working on the UK’s fleet of operational or decommissioning nuclear power plants is highly desirable

**Our Culture**

Our values are built on a strong foundation of safety, integrity, and respect for every individual. People are at the heart of our mission, and we believe in supporting one another through a culture of care and collaboration.

We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. Supporting mental wellbeing and fostering a sense of connection are essential to how we work.

When we embrace different perspectives and work together, we become more innovative, more agile, and more successful.

We partner with VERCIDA, for greater online accessibility please visit www.vercida.com to view and access our roles. As a Disability Confident employer, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for a vacancy. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.

If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team.

* Prepare technical documentation, specifications, and design justifications for safety-critical systems
* Support requirements capture and systems engineering approach for new architectures
* Demonstrate knowledge of the practical aspects of implementing engineering designs and understand the use of standards and compliance with regulatory requirements in an engineering environment
* Manage and check deliverables from junior engineers to ensure compliance and quality
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced engineers
* Interface with clients, regulators, and project stakeholders on technical matters
* Ensure designs meet nuclear safety, cybersecurity, and quality standards
* Support project planning, cost estimating, and risk management activities
* Produce high-quality technical reports
* Build and maintain valuable relationships with clients, partners and peers

**Skills and Qualificati**ons (the following list outlines desirable skills and qualifications. While these attributes are valued, we understand that applicants may not possess all of them. We therefore encourage applications from individuals with relevant experience and potential):

  

* MEng, MSc, BEng or BSc or equivalent in Electrical Engineering or another relevant discipline
* Chartered or near Chartered Engineer status with a relevant professional body (we will support you)
* An awareness of civil nuclear plant systems, structures and components and associated design and assessment guidelines (or relevant engineering principles from other highly regulated industries)
* Knowledge of HV systems with a focus on:
* 11kV Switchboards, 20 KV Insulated phase busducts, Generator Circuit breaker, Stems related to 20kV generators, Power transformers around 70MVA and 600MVA (Generator Transformer), 400kV connection to National Grid, Grid Code, 400kV switchgears, grid interface requirement, etc, Interfacing between HV packages and the wider EC&I infrastructure
* Preparation of specification, preparing datasheet for HV systems, preparation of drawings related to HV systems (SLD, Metering and protection drawing, support layout drawings, etc)
* Understanding of Electrical System Analysis (ETAP is beneficial, but not mandatory)
* Knowledge or EC&I principals, design tools and relevant guidelines, standards and practices (e.g., BS, IEC, IEEE – in particular IEC 61508, 61511, 61513, 61226 and ONR SAPs / TAGS)
* Knowledge and experience in the systematic design lifecycle of a C&I system; including speciﬁcation, design, assessment, veriﬁcation, testing, installation, commissioning and maintenance of safety or process critical I&C Systems
* Ability to simplify complex problems
* Knowledge of high integrity hardware or software-based control systems for industrial equipment, knowledge of Systems Engineering and system conceptual design is desirable

**Our Cultur**e

Our values are built on a strong foundation of safety, integrity, and respect for every individual. People are at the heart of our mission, and we believe in supporting one another through a culture of care and collaboration.

We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. Supporting mental wellbeing and fostering a sense of connection are essential to how we work.

* Co-ordinate multi-discipline engineering teams to deliver complex engineering solutions to time, cost and quality on projects of varying sizes
* Marshall projects through an investment delivery process, from FEED to solution delivery
* Act as Architect Engineer on projects, taking ownership of technical challenges, developing strategies, and managing stakeholders and interfaces in order to implement technical solutions
* Development and delivery of clear engineering strategies
* Manage significant number of varied stakeholders
* Deliver projects across a typical project lifecycle, including bidding, definition of requirements, design and implementation, into delivery of commissioned systems ready to support the needs of our clients

* Identify and manage technical risks
* Support the Project Manager with respect to resourcing and financial elements, such as costs and schedule, and supporting change control and identification and control of technical risks

* Chartered Engineer, Fellow or similar demonstrable experience
* A Mechanical, Process, EC&I, Structural Integrity or Civils technical background is essential
* Self-starter with a professional leadership approach and a technical background
* Nuclear industry, and/or equivalent safety case, experience
* Demonstrable experience in leading and managing multidiscipline teams
* Proven experience of engineering delivery within a nuclear or highly regulated environment
* Motivated team member with the ability to work to deadlines and communicate project progress
* Good communication skills and ability to articulate information to a broad range of stakeholders
* Ability to produce a project strategy to solve technical problems and take ownership of all the interfaces to implement the solution
* Experience of executing project tasks against relevant codes, standards, and best practices
* Knowledge of Project Management principles and experience of handling change control and making informed judgements to control or mitigate project risks
* Committed to Continuous Professional Development of self and others
* Previous experience working on the UK’s fleet of operational or decommissioning nuclear power plants is highly desirable
