jobs.title: Interim Software Development Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
------------------

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Interim Software Development Manager to lead our Software Development function in a 12-month fixed term contract. This is a key leadership role responsible for ensuring the successful delivery, support and continuous improvement of secure, resilient and high-quality software solutions that underpin critical business services.

Leading teams across a diverse technology landscape including RPG, Visualfiles, .NET and Java, you will provide technical leadership, operational oversight and people management while working closely with our Architecture, Security, Solution Delivery and Governance teams.

You will be responsible for driving engineering excellence, embedding effective development practices and ensuring delivery remains aligned with business priorities. Alongside supporting day-to-day development and application support activities, you will play a vital role in modernising approaches, improving delivery processes and strengthening the overall capability of the function.

As an interim leader, you will quickly assess the current environment, identify opportunities for improvement and implement practical solutions that deliver lasting value. By the end of the assignment, you will leave behind clear processes, documented ways of working and a roadmap for future success.

Key responsibilities include:

* Leading and developing Software Development Team Leaders across multiple technology stacks.
* Driving a high-performing, collaborative and customer-focused engineering culture.
* Overseeing end-to-end software delivery across a broad application portfolio.
* Championing Agile delivery practices, Azure DevOps governance and CI/CD maturity.
* Managing application support, incident triage and continuous service improvement.
* Collaborating with Architecture, Security, Solution Delivery and Governance teams to ensure solutions are secure, compliant and aligned with strategic objectives.
* Supporting application stability, resilience and operational performance.
* Managing third-party suppliers, technical dependencies and delivery risks.
* Identifying opportunities to modernise legacy platforms and improve engineering capability.

**About You**
-------------

You will be an experienced software development leader who can quickly establish credibility, provide direction and drive meaningful improvements within a complex technology environment.

You will have a strong technical background and be comfortable engaging in discussions around software engineering, architecture, security and application support. You will combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic, hands-on approach and be confident leading multiple teams through change and improvement initiatives.

You will also bring:

* Proven experience in a Software Development Manager, Head of Development or similar leadership role.
* Experience leading multiple development teams across a range of technology platforms and software stacks.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, DevOps principles and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience overseeing Azure DevOps, including Boards, Repositories and Pipelines.
* A track record of improving delivery performance, operational resilience and engineering standards.
* Experience managing application support functions, incident resolution and continual service improvement.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
* Experience working alongside Architecture, Security, Governance and Delivery functions within a structured technology environment.
* Excellent communication, leadership and people development skills.
* The ability to quickly assess challenges, establish priorities and deliver results within an interim assignment.

**About The Company**
---------------------

ARAG UK has been helping businesses and individuals gain access to justice for over 40 years. It’s our founding principle to enable everybody, not just those who can afford it, to assert their legal rights.

Thousands of businesses and individuals defend or pursue legal action each year safe in the knowledge that ARAG are paying their legal bills. Our businesses include a legal expenses insurance company and a law firm with many opportunities in both areas.

We have always been aware that it’s the people that really make it happen; the quality of our people defines the quality of the company, the service we offer and the good outcomes for our customers, so we’re committed to creating a great place to work for our employees.

We believe it is an exciting time to join ARAG. You can expect an organisation that will challenge and develop you to progress your career.

By giving you every opportunity to develop yourself professionally and personally, we also pride ourselves on having an open, inclusive and high energy culture that encourages a fun working environment and places our customers at the very heart of everything we do.

If you are keen to become part of our exciting future then we would love to hear from you. In addition to the very genuine development opportunities we provide we also offer a generous reward and benefits package.

**Job Title:**

Scientific Software Engineer Intern (3 months) - Starting Summer 2027

*Project Title: Development of a Boundary Element Method Solver for Porous Media Flow*

**About SLB:**

We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

  

At SLB we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. That is our purpose. As innovators, that has been our mission for 100 years. Our purpose: Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. You can find out more about us on https://www.slb.com/who-we-are

**Location:**

Abingdon, Oxofrdshire

**Description & Scope:**

The internship project focuses on developing a 2D solver for fluid flow in porous media as a simplified reservoir model. The solver will be based on the boundary element method (BEM), offering an efficient approach for simulating flow without the need for full volumetric discretization.

An important aspect of the project is enabling the solver to handle embedded elements, such as wells and fractures, which play a critical role in controlling flow behavior. The scope includes implementing the core solver, extending it to represent these embedded features, and validating the results on simplified test cases. This work will provide the intern with hands-on experience in scientific computing, numerical methods, and reservoir modeling, while contributing a practical tool for exploring innovative simulation techniques.

* Contribute to the extension of an existing 2D boundary element solver for fluid flow in porous media.
* The main task will be to add support for embedded elements such as wells and fractures, ensuring that these features are correctly represented in the simulation.
* Implementing the new functionality, testing it on simple cases, and documenting the results.
* Deliverables will be an extended solver prototype, validation of results,
* Create a technical report.

  

Through this project, the student will gain valuable experience in numerical modeling, scientific programming, and applied mathematics. They will also learn how to incorporate physical features like wells and fractures into simulation tools, and how simplified reservoir models can be used to study complex subsurface behavior. By the end of the internship, the student will have hands-on experience enhancing a solver that connects theory, coding, and reservoir applications.

**Qualifications****:**

* Studying a Bachelors or Masters in Applied Mathematics, Numerical Analysis, Software Engineering or a related discipline
* Partial Differental Equations
* Numerical Analysis
Software Engineering

jobs.title: Engineering Manager (Core)
jobs.description:
At **Ocean Infinity**, we're on a bold mission to subsea data using innovative technology.

Using cutting-edge robotics, autonomous technology and world-class software, we're transforming how complex operations are carried out at sea. Our uncrewed systems are making ocean exploration and operations **safer, smarter and more sustainable**, helping unlock the vast potential of our oceans while reducing environmental impact.

This isn't a vision for the future. **It's happening right now.**

As we continue to push the boundaries of innovation and redefine what's possible in the maritime industry, we're looking for exceptional talent to join our fast-growing team.

Ocean Infinity is looking for an Engineering Manager to own the people, organisational capability and engineering capacity of a group of engineers within our Core Engineering team ( C#/.NET **or** Node/TypeScript). This is a senior people-leadership role: rather than owning the technical architecture or product priority, your role is to make sure the engineers in your group are well managed, performing to the best of their abilities, and developed and deployed against the organisation’s priorities.

You’ll work closely with team leads to keep technical leadership and people management aligned as the engineering group grows, and hold responsibility for building a scalable engineering team.

 **Requirements**

**What you will do!**

* Line-manage a group of engineers: run regular 1:1s, give feedback, and own their career development.
* Own performance management, recognition and reward for your engineers.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding and retention across your group.
* Own capacity and resource planning – decide where engineering resource is deployed and flag constraints early.
* Work with engineers to allocate them to projects, and manage workload to ensure projects can be delivered on time and with a high level of quality.
* Work with the product team and other team leads to resolve resource constraints and balance competing demands for capacity.
* Build the succession and technical leadership pipeline within your group, and identify capability gaps before they affect the team.
* Protect team health, engagement and working environment, and escalate organisational, staffing or performance issues that threaten delivery.

**What we look for!**

* Several years’ experience managing and developing software engineers, ideally within a scaling engineering organisation.
* A track record of hiring, retaining and developing engineering talent, including into more senior or lead roles.
* Comfortable balancing competing demands for engineering capacity across multiple concurrent projects or squads.
* Strong 1:1, coaching and feedback skills, with the judgement to handle performance issues fairly and directly.
* Enough technical credibility in engineering to earn the trust of the engineers you manage – you don’t need to own the technology, but you need to know how it works.
* Comfortable with capacity/resource planning and making trade-off calls under constraint.
* Genuine care for people’s development, combined with the willingness to have hard conversations about performance.

**Nice to have! ✨**

* Experience managing distributed or multi-location teams.
* Previous experience in marine, defence, or aerospace.

  
**Benefits**

***\*Salary: London up to £135,000 / Porto up to 95,000 EUR Per Annum\****

jobs.title: Engineering Industrial Placement
jobs.description:
About the Role

At EDF, Success is Personal. We don’t define it, you do. Join our Engineering Industrial Placement and you’ll shape your future while helping Britain achieve net zero. You’ll take on real responsibilities, learn from experienced professionals, and contribute to meaningful projects at one of our operational nuclear sites.  
  
“Electricity is such a vital component in everyone’s lives. It powers schools, businesses and hospitals, so I knew that if I did my placement within EDF then I would have a really large impact on society, and that made my placement a lot more fulfilling.” Priyanka, Science and Engineering Industrial Placement  
  
**The Opportunity**  
  
This 12-month placement offers a starting salary of £26,050 and the chance to work at our #Torness Power Station in Scotland.  
  
You’ll apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges in the energy industry. From safety improvements to radiation protection and condition monitoring, this placement offers a wide range of learning opportunities that will help you grow professionally and personally.  
  
**What You’ll Experience**  
  
During your Engineering Industrial Placement, you’ll work on projects that previous students have found rewarding. These include supporting safety campaigns, exploring radiation protection in new power stations, and helping maintain condition monitoring programmes across operational sites.  
  
You’ll be part of a collaborative team, applying your engineering skills to practical challenges and gaining insight into the operations of a nuclear power station. This is a chance to build your confidence, develop technical expertise, and make a real impact.  
  
**Your Work Location**  
  
You’ll be based at our #Torness Power Station in Scotland (EH42), where you’ll work on site and connect with colleagues across the business.  
  
**Who You Are**  
  
To be eligible for this EDF industrial placement, you need to be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, a 2:2 undergraduate or postgraduate degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering , Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering or Chemical Engineering.  
  
It is a requirement that those who join us have the right to work in the UK. Whilst sponsorship may be a possibility, we reserve the right in our decisions to give priority to those who already have the right to work in the UK.  
  
To be appointed to this role, you will need to meet the criteria for Security Vetting, which will, ordinarily, require you to have been a resident of the UK for at least three of the past five years.  
  
**Pay, Benefits and Culture**  
  
Alongside a starting salary of at least £26,050 per annum and a market-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.  
  
At EDF, we believe there are multiple definitions of what it means to succeed. That’s why we offer you the freedom to develop a career that’s unique to you. Here, Success is Personal – it’s your journey, powered by us.  
  
Everyone is welcome at EDF; we’re committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility, and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ+ communities, and those with disabilities.  
  
As a Disability Confident employer, we're committed to creating an accessible recruitment process and encourage candidates to tell us about any support they may need. Should you disclose a disability and meet the minimum criteria (which will include holding a relevant degree discipline/grade and achieving the required pass mark for Stage 1 Testing) for the role you’ll be progressed to the first stage of the selection process. Some of our roles at EDF attract large volumes of applications. When this happens, we’ll apply the Disability Confident scheme’s guidance on taking practical and appropriate steps selecting disabled candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job.  
  
**Our Recruitment Process**  
  
We'll guide you through every stage and keep you updated along the way. You'll be supported by real people, with opportunities to ask questions, learn more and receive feedback where possible.  
  
For our Early Careers Programmes, we use a combination of automated decision-making, assessment technology and human review.  
  
Find out more by visiting: https://careers.edfenergy.com/articles/2025-8/AI-and-Automated-Decision-Making-in-Recruitment-at-EDF

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**About us**

We're a Manchester-based FinTech building a smarter way for tenants to pay rent. Our platform pays landlords the full rent on time and collects smaller instalments from tenants via Open Banking Variable Recurring Payments (VRP). We're a small, high-trust engineering team solving genuinely hard problems in payments, credit, and financial correctness — where getting the maths and the money movement exactly right matters.

**The role**

We're looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to own features end-to-end across our .NET backend and React Native mobile client. You'll work close to the domain — instalment maths, double-entry ledgers, scheduled money movement, and third-party integrations with banking and identity providers. This is a hands-on senior role with real ownership and influence over architecture.

**What you'll work with**

* **Backend:** .NET 10 / C#, EF Core (SQL Server), a service-oriented solution with clean domain boundaries
* **Async & messaging:** MassTransit, background workers, durable/idempotent scheduled jobs
* **Cloud & platform:** Azure, .NET Aspire, containerised services
* **Mobile:** Expo / React Native (TypeScript)
* **Integrations:** Open Banking, VRP, BaaS, identity verification, credit decisioning
* **Practices:** ADR-driven architecture, EF Core migrations, automated testing (MSTest, NSubstitute, FluentAssertions)

**What you'll do**

* Design and ship features spanning the C# backend and the React Native app
* Model financial domains carefully — money, fees, timing differences, ledgers — where precision is non-negotiable
* Build resilient, idempotent background processing for payment execution and scheduling
* Integrate with external banking, payments, and identity providers
* Contribute to architectural decisions

**What we are looking for**

* Strong commercial experience with **C# / .NET** and modern **TypeScript**
* **Solid EF Core** / relational database skills (SQL Server ideal)
* Experience building and consuming APIs, and working with asynchronous/message-based systems
* **React Native (Expo)** experience, or strong React skills and appetite to work across mobile
* A pragmatic, quality-first mindset — you care about correctness, testing, and clear design
* Bonus: FinTech / payments / Open Banking experience, cloud (Azure), event-driven architecture

**Benefits**

* £65k–£85k salary depending on experience
* Hybrid working from our Manchester office
* 25 days holiday + bank holidays
* Pension, and the chance to shape a product (and a team) from an early stage
* Meaningful ownership and a direct line to the impact of your work
* **Sound like you?** Apply with your CV and a short note on something you've built that you're proud of.

Pay: £65,000.00-£85,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Manchester, Greater Manchester: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Application question(s):

* Do you now or in the future require sponsorship for a work visa?
* What are your base salary expectations?

Experience:

* C#: 5 years (required)
* React Native: 2 years (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Manchester

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
BU1 Powertrain and Charging

Together, we move the world—we’ve been doing it for over 100 years. At MAHLE, as a leading international development partner and systems supplier to the automotive industry, we pursue the objective of making mobility more efficient, more environmentally friendly, more convenient, and more economical. As part of our dual strategy, we are working both on the intelligent combustion engine for the use of hydrogen and other nonfossil fuels and on technologies for fuel cells and e-mobility.  
  
MAHLE generated sales of €11.3 billion in 2025. Employing just under 65,000 people at 127 production locations and 11 technology centers, the company is represented in 28 countries. (as at: 12/31/2025). Join our MAHLE team! #weshapefuturemobility

We are looking for an enthusiastic professional to desig and implement more complex systems independently and troubleshooting problems. Capable to lead projects, drive technological innovation, and focus on advanced research.

  

**Your Contribution**

  

* System design and implementation: Develop and deploy automated vision systems for tasks like defect detection, object recognition, robot guidance and dimensional measurement in high volume manufacturing and production environments.
* Programming and configuration: Program and integrate system components such as cameras, lenses, and lighting, and configuring software using tool likes PyTorch or TensorFlow for Deep Learning, Optical Character Recognition (OCR/OCV), and Data Matrix Code.
* Testing and optimization: Validate system performance to ensure accuracy and efficiency, often using data analysis to improve model performance and reduce inference time. An understanding of Measurement System Analysis (MSA) and QDAS software would be preferable.
* Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams, including quality assurance, operations, and mechanical and electrical development, to gather requirements and integrate vision systems into broader automation platforms.
* Troubleshooting and maintenance: Provide support and perform diagnostics on existing vision systems to ensure continuous, accurate operation.
* Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation, including validation protocols and user manuals.

  

**Your Qualifications & Experience**

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering (e.g., Computer, Electrical, or Mechanical), Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Programming languages: Proficiency in VB.NET, Python, and C#. A knowledge of C++.is preferable.
* Computer vision expertise: Strong understanding of image processing, feature extraction, and object detection techniques.
* Machine and deep learning: Experience with deep learning frameworks like Cognex DeepLearning and a solid grasp of concepts like neural networks.
* Analytical skills: Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and logical reasoning abilities are needed to optimize complex visual data and algorithms.
* Attention to detail: A keen eye for visual anomalies and subtle patterns is critical for ensuring system accuracy.

**IMPORTANT: Location & Relocation Requirement**

  

This position will be based in the United Kingdom for the first two years of employment. Following this initial period, the role will permanently relocate to Slovakia. As such, the successful candidate must be willing and able to relocate to Slovakia after two years.

  

The company will provide support with the required immigration and work authorisation processes, including:

jobs.title: Front End Developer
jobs.description:
MYCO helps people start, run, and manage UK businesses. More than 70,000 clients have used our company formation, address, mail, call answering, meeting room, and compliance services. We are bringing those services into a clearer, connected digital experience. Our client-facing estate includes public websites, account and service tools, checkout, help centre, and embedded experiences. The products serve new founders, established businesses, MYCO clients, and the teams supporting them.

**About the role**

We are looking for a product-focused Frontend Developer with strong UI craft. You will take hands-on ownership across MYCO's client-facing surfaces, from public marketing journeys to authenticated tools and checkout.

This is a broad role for someone comfortable moving between visual detail and application complexity. You might build a polished landing page, improve a multi-step form, shape an account workflow, or strengthen a shared component used across several products.

You will work with product, design, marketing, operations, and backend engineering. Some work will begin with detailed designs. Other work will start with a customer problem, a rough concept, or an existing journey needing improvement. You should enjoy turning each into accessible, maintainable software.

Our frontend applications use React, Next.js, and TypeScript. They share UI foundations, CMS content, catalogue data, and analytics. Frontends are hosted on Vercel and integrate with a .NET backend backed by Microsoft SQL Server on Azure.

**What you will do**

* Build and improve MYCO's websites, client tools, checkout, help centre, and embedded experiences.
* Turn designs and early concepts into responsive, accessible production interfaces.
* Own customer journeys across marketing, account creation, purchase, and service management.
* Develop shared components and patterns that improve consistency across products.
* Work with Payload CMS content while protecting performance, usability, and design quality.
* Integrate frontend applications with .NET APIs and third-party services.
* Use customer behaviour, analytics, and team feedback to improve shipped work.
* Test your work and help strengthen practical frontend quality standards.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to explore, build, and iterate efficiently.
* Review generated work carefully and remain accountable for every shipped change.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong production experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* Evidence of owning meaningful frontend work from problem to release.
* Sound knowledge of semantic HTML, modern CSS, responsive design, and browser behaviour.
* A strong eye for composition, hierarchy, typography, interaction, and visual detail.
* Experience building accessible interfaces and applying WCAG guidance in practice.
* Confidence working with forms, validation, API data, loading states, and error handling.
* An understanding of frontend performance, maintainability, and reusable component design.
* Experience testing frontend behaviour with suitable automated and manual techniques.
* Confidence with Git, GitHub pull requests, code review, and CI/CD workflows.
* A practical AI-assisted workflow using tools such as Cursor, Codex, Claude, or equivalent.
* Good judgement about when to move quickly and when a customer journey needs deeper care.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

We are hiring at mid-to-senior level, but we do not use years of experience as a rigid filter. We care more about the scope you have owned, the decisions you can explain, and the quality of what you have shipped.

**Nice to watch**

* Experience with Tailwind CSS and Radix or shadcn component patterns.
* Experience contributing to a shared component library or design system.
* Familiarity with Payload CMS or another headless content platform.
* Experience integrating with .NET APIs.
* Familiarity with Stripe and customer-facing commerce journeys.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar planning and documentation tools.
* Experience improving accessibility, performance, analytics, or conversion.
* Familiarity with regulated or identity-sensitive customer journeys.

Please share a portfolio, shipped product, code sample, or another example that shows how you approach frontend work. Tell us what you owned, the problem you addressed, and the decisions you made.

You do not need to meet every item to apply. If the role fits your strengths and direction, we would like to hear from you. We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

Must be eligible to work in the U.K.

Employees may be subject to a DBS check.

Pay: £42,000.00-£45,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Description**

As a Computer Vision Engineer, you'll join a collaborative team developing SLAM, perception and sensor-fusion capabilities for real-world navigation and mapping products. The role sits at the intersection of computer vision, navigation, geospatial data and embedded systems.

With the support from experienced colleagues, you'll contribute to products and technologies used across automotive testing, autonomous systems, surveying and mobile mapping applications.

If you've worked on projects that combine LIDAR, Cameras, GPS, accelerometers or gyroscopes on a moving platform, we'd love to hear from you!

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

We’re looking for someone who can:

* Apply software engineering, mathematical and analytical skills to solve interesting technical problems and support the continued development of OXTS products.
* Help us developing software that combines LIDAR, cameras, Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), inertial sensors and advanced mathematical techniques to deliver highly accurate positioning, orientation, motion and mapping data.
* Contribute to technical investigations, algorithm evaluation, experimental analysis and innovation activities that support future product development and technical roadmaps.
* Take responsibility for technical deliverables, have autonomy over your day-to-day engineering work, and keep growing your expertise while collaborating with colleagues on shared team and project goals.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

Essentials

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, related Degree or equivalent experience.
* A genuine interest in continued learning and professional development
* Experience in at least one of: computer vision, SLAM, robotics, mapping, perception and/or sensor-fusion systems.
* Experience delivering production-quality engineering software.
* Understanding of software architecture, code quality, testing and CI/CD.

Nice to have

* Experience with LiDAR and camera data processing.
* Experience with IMU/GNSS-aided sensor fusion.
* Experience with C++, C# or Python in engineering software.
* Familiarity with Linux, Docker, CUDA or GPU acceleration.
* Understanding of navigation, localisation or mapping products.
* Familiarity with React or web-based visualisation tools.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to improve engineering productivity.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Discretionary annual profit share bonus
* 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays
* 5% employee and 5% employer contributions through our via our salary sacrifice workplace pension scheme
* Group Income Protection Insurance Scheme
* Private Medical Insurance
* Death In Service Scheme
* Electric Vehicle Scheme
* Smart casual dress code

  

### **About OXTS**

At OXTS we’re passionate about inertial navigation and how we can help our customers with our technology. With two decades of experience in combining the best of high precision GNSS receivers and world-class inertial navigation expertise, OXTS’ products have become the industry standard for automotive testing and are widely used in other industries.  
  
The highly accurate RT3000 products are the equipment of choice for vehicle dynamics testing. Our products are used by major car manufacturers and automotive test facilities around the world for applications such as handling and dynamics evaluation, brake testing, steering robot guidance and many more. With the RT-Range S products, OXTS also offers a complete solution for validating advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) to Euro and global NCAP standards and for developing the self-driving cars of the future.  
  
Away from the automotive world, our range of combined, compact GNSS/INS systems are also used for airborne and vehicle-based survey and mobile mapping applications, where continuous position and high accuracy orientation information is essential for georeferencing sensor data.  
  
OXTS’ GNSS/INS products are supplied with a comprehensive software suite including powerful data analysis and post-processing applications. We also provide a full technical support service, plus a bespoke technology integration consultancy via our Application Engineering department. Our products are sold and supported globally through a network of channel partners in more than 20 countries worldwide, to provide customers with a local point of contact and support.

**Location:**

Stonehouse, Gloucestershire

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Modeling and Simulation Engineer with strong physics-based system modelling expertise in Matlab/SimuLink/SimScape to support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) development. This role sits within a multidisciplinary embedded software team and is responsible for developing real-time models, virtual prototypes, and simulation techniques used to design, integrate, validate, and deploy complex control systems to simulate virtual environments to our products.

  

The successful candidate will contribute to modelling power electronics, motor drives, and sensor networks, while supporting product development through simulation-driven design, validation, and hardware deployment. The role also involves advancing modelling methodologies, supporting commercialization efforts, and collaborating across engineering teams.

**Typical Responsibilities and Duties:**

  

**HIL Development & Real-Time Modeling**

* Develop, implement, and validate Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations for engineering applications.
* Design and model control systems using Simulink and Simscape with emphasis on real-time behaviour.
* Create and optimize models for power electronics including switches, MOSFETs, and inverters, etc.
* Model motor systems such as PMSM and BLDC, along with sensors including accelerometers, IMUs, and magnetometers, etc.
* Compile and deploy models for execution on NI hardware targets ensuring robust integration and performance. Our existing toolchain enables easy compilation with single click functionality.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support seamless hardware-software interaction.
* Engage with our partners in MathWorks/National Instruments to improve our modelling capabilities
* Engage with the central team to produce highly reusable models to build our library of models within the business.

  

**Modeling, Simulation & Virtual Prototyping**

* Develop and maintain physics-based models of systems, subsystems, and components.
* Create virtual prototypes of new products and optimize designs using computational tools.
* Apply modeling and simulation technologies to product development needs.
* Integrate and evaluate system, subsystem, and component designs.
* Validate and improve product robustness and performance through simulation.
* Conduct research and recommend improvements to modeling techniques and criteria.
* Use version control tools to manage model revisions according to internal processes

  

**Product Development & Engineering Support**

* Analyze, design, develop, and maintain products and assist in commercialization.
* Scope new products, evaluate feasibility, and support engineering specification definition.
* Estimate development, validation, and documentation effort with project leadership.
* Define testing procedures for models, algorithms, workflows, and products.
* Conduct tests, document results, and provide corrective actions for defects.
* Support implementation, testing, and sustaining of products.

  

**Technical Leadership & Innovation**

* Investigate new development areas within modeling and simulation engineering.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies and industry practices.
* Participate in technical reviews, audits, and design evaluations.
* Contribute to modeling standards, best practices, and design reuse initiatives.
* Support innovation activities including patents, technical papers, and research collaboration.
* Mentor team members and share expertise across the organization.

  

**Documentation, Communication & Collaboration**

* Create and maintain project and technical documentation.
* Contribute technical content for product documentation and training materials.
* Provide training and support to other collaborators.
* Deliver presentations to technical and management audiences.
* Participate in internal seminars, industry forums, and conferences.

  

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, or related discipline.
* Hands-on experience with NI FPGA and VeriStand FMU platforms. Familiarity with dSPACE, Speedgoat, or similar real-time environments is considered.
* Model architecting and Simulink toolchain – Systems Composer, Requirements manager, Test Manager.
* Experience with model validation and computational optimization techniques.
* Familiarity with LabVIEW is desirable.
  

*Required Technical Skills*

* Advanced proficiency in Simulink and Simscape for control system modelling.
* Experience with real-time system modelling in HIL environments.
* Strong understanding of power electronics, motor drives, and sensor modelling.
* Experience developing physics-based models and virtual prototypes.
* Experience compiling models for hardware targets and integrating with physical systems.
  

*Desirable Skills*

* Strong system-level thinking and technical curiosity.
* Proactive approach to problem-solving and innovation.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and project requirements.
* Interest in mentoring and knowledge sharing.

  

**Career Advancement:**

SLB Eureka Technical Career (SETC) provides proven technical contributors with a career path that offers them recognition, reward, and influence that parallels an equivalent management progression. We are leaders in Technology Domain Knowledge – Our Eureka Community of practice has over 28,500 members, in 30 communities, with 123 Special Interest Groups (SIGs). jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Materials Capability Acquisition Engineer**

**Solihull**

**Permanent Full-Time**

**Hybrid**

**Staff 7 - 10**

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Materials Capability Acquisition Engineer to join our Materials Engineering Team in Solihull. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically skilled engineer to take on a key role in a major development programme, helping shape production readiness in advanced metallic materials, heat treatment processes, and joining technologies. You’ll be at the forefront of innovation, turning cutting-edge materials capability into real-world manufacturing success.

  

**Why join Rolls-Royce?**

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

  

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

  

**What you will be doing:**

As Rolls-Royce accelerates towards its Net Zero ambitions, developing the next generation of low-emission combustion technologies is a critical priority. This role sits at the heart of that journey.

  

You’ll take ownership of delivering complex materials characterisation work packages through the full technology development lifecycle — leveraging/collaborating with expert contributors, coordinating technical inputs, and ensuring milestones are achieved on time and within budget. "This is a position offering opportunities for technical contribution and involvement in strategic initiatives, with scope for collaboration and moderate influence.

  

* Responsible for defined technical packages of work within Materials Capability Acquisition, providing leadership and delivery against program milestones within agreed costs, timescales and quality requirements.
* Manage the inputs from a team of metallurgical experts, to compile reports and project review packs to a high standard for review at technical committees, to the requirements of the technology development process.
* Plan, develop and run metallic materials characterisation testing programs at external test houses to de-risk and address knowledge gaps.
* Resolve problems through evaluative judgements.
* Become a point of contact within Materials Capability Acquisition and to share subject matter knowledge across the function.
* Acting as advisor / coach on matters where they are technically authoritative.
* Understand company business objectives and ensure that the work they do supports this; to act in accordance with both the company values and those associated with being a professional engineer.
* Actively promote, encourage and support the identification and implementation of continuous improvement both within and outside their immediate sphere and prompt action across the wider team.
* Maintain and develop an external network to deliver relevant technology and maintain awareness of competitive position and emerging technologies.
* Identify appropriate internal and / or external funding opportunities and exploit as appropriate.
  

**Who we are looking for:**

You will be a technically credible leader driving key development programmes and ensuring production readiness across advanced metallic materials, heat treatment processes, and joining technologies. This is a chance to influence cutting-edge engineering that will shape future aerospace capability.

  

* Bachelor's degree, Master's degree or PhD in Engineering or equivalent technical capability, based on practical knowledge and experience.
* Proven technical leadership and a team player, with ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, on time and to budget.
* Excellent communication, presentation and technical report writing skills.
* Sound understanding of metallurgy. Knowledge in the field of high temperature nickel alloys considered advantageous.
* Structured, goal-oriented, resilient work attitude and high motivation to solve challenges in a strong team.
* An ability to apply logical, analytical and innovative thinking on a range of technical problems.
* Knowledge and experience of product integrity / liability and certification frameworks.
* Membership in a relevant professional body and attained / working towards Chartered status is preferred.
  

**Regional Benefits:**

* Work in a safety-first environment were doing the right thing and keeping it simple are core principles.
* Join a culture that values making a real difference through your work.
* Develop your career as a mid-career professional blending technical expertise with strong personal qualities.
* Thrive in a role that encourages integrity, accountability, resilience, and curiosity.
* Collaborate and build relationships in a team-focused environment while also working independently.
* Take initiative, lead, and make smart decisions with confidence and support.
* Grow through continuous learning, openness to improvement, and exposure to challenging opportunities.
  

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

  

Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

As part of our selection process, candidates in certain locations may be asked to complete an online assessment, which can include cognitive and behavioural aptitude testing relevant to the role. If required, full instructions for the next steps will be provided.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

As an Account Executive on our UK Public Sector team, you will own the Defence territory: selling the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to the Ministry of Defence, defence primes, system integrators, and allied national security organisations. This is a mission-driven, field-based role for someone who understands how data transforms Defence outcomes and can navigate the sensitivities of secure and sovereign environments.

**As an Account Executive you will:**

* Prospect, win, and onboard net-new Defence logos across the UK, breaking into MOD commands, defence primes, and strategic SIs that are not yet Snowflake customers
* Run complex, consultative sales cycles that align the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to mission priorities such as readiness, logistics, intelligence, and command and control
* Position Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, and secure data sharing for sovereign, air-gapped, and high-assurance workloads
* Partner with Solution Engineers to design architectures that meet Defence security, residency, and accreditation requirements
* Navigate UK public sector procurement, including G-Cloud, Digital Outcomes, and framework and direct-award routes
* Build trusted relationships with mission owners, programme leads, and procurement, from technical practitioners to senior leadership
* Collaborate with partners, resellers, and cleared delivery teams to land and expand mission-critical data programmes
* Forecast accurately and manage pipeline through the full sales cycle, from qualification to close and expansion

**Our Ideal Account Executive Will Have:**

* 5+ years of enterprise software, SaaS, or data platform sales experience, with consistent quota overachievement
* A proven track record selling into UK Defence
* Experience with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and long-horizon programme engagements
* Working knowledge of UK public sector procurement frameworks and the realities of secure or classified environments
* Fluency in articulating the value of data, analytics, and AI to mission outcomes
* Strong commercial discipline across territory planning, forecasting, and negotiation
* The ability to hold or obtain UK security clearance (SC or above) as required by the territory

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

* Experience selling cloud data platforms, data warehousing, or AI and machine learning solutions
* An existing network across MOD, defence primes, or allied agencies
* Familiarity with secure data sharing, data sovereignty, and high-assurance deployment patterns
* Experience working alongside system integrators and cleared delivery partners

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking an exceptional, high-caliber **Senior Software Engineer / Developer** to join our **Commodities Technology** team based in **London**. Sitting at the intersection of quantitative and high-performance software engineering, this role is dedicated to delivering mission-critical market data infrastructure, services, and analytics feeds for our global Commodities trading desks.

As a senior individual contributor in a front-office environment, you will drive the architecture, design, and implementation of robust, low-latency market data pipelines and services across Commodities asset classes (Energy, Metals, Agriculture) with cross-asset touchpoints in FX, Rates, and Equities. You will partner directly with Front Office Traders, Model Quantitative Analysis (MQA / Quants), Market Risk, and Operations teams to build scalable solutions and integrate next-generation Generative AI and Agentic AI workflows into the development and trading lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

**1. System Engineering & Architecture**

* Architect, build, and optimize scalable, resilient, and high-throughput market data engines, curve builders, pricing integration layers, and real-time distribution services.
* Design and implement clean, modular APIs and event-driven architectures leveraging modern design patterns across **Java, Python, or .NET (C#)** ecosystems.
* Ensure ultra-reliable delivery of tick, end-of-day, and historical market data feeds to quantitative pricing libraries and trading applications.

**2. Front Office & Desk Alignment**

* Act as a direct technical partner to Front Office trading desks, understanding business drivers and rapidly translating complex trading/pricing requirements into production-ready software.
* Collaborate closely with **MQA (Quantitative Analysts)** to integrate pricing models, risk calculators, and real-time analytics.

**3. AI & Innovation Driver**

* Champion the adoption of **Generative AI** and **Agentic AI** frameworks within the software development lifecycle (e.g., automated code reviews, synthesis, workflow orchestration, agent-driven monitoring/troubleshooting).
* Prototype and evaluate agentic workflows for automated anomaly detection, market data quality validation, and intelligent developer tooling.

**4. Technical Leadership & Excellence**

* Drive engineering best practices: test-driven development (TDD), CI/CD pipelines, containerization, comprehensive observability, and low-latency performance tuning.
* Take end-to-end ownership of delivery—from requirement analysis and technical design to deployment, production monitoring, and support.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Technical Competencies**

* **Core Programming:** Advanced proficiency in at least one primary backend language:
  + **Java** (Modern Java, Spring Boot, concurrency, low-latency tuning, GC optimization), OR
  + **Python** (Modern Python, asynchronous programming, NumPy/Pandas, FastAPI), OR
  + **.NET / C#** (Modern .NET Core, multi-threading, asynchronous I/O, memory profiling).
* **Distributed Systems & Messaging:** Strong experience with enterprise messaging and streaming frameworks (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Solace, ZeroMQ, or gRPC).
* **Data Storage & Analytics:** Proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server) and time-series/caching technologies (e.g., Redis, InfluxDB, KDB+/q, or similar).
* **Modern DevOps & Cloud:** Practical experience with Git, CI/CD automation (e.g., GitHub , Tekton, Jenkins), Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift, and Linux operating systems.
* **AI Tooling & Automation:** Demonstrated familiarity with LLMs, GenAI tools, and Agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP tools, automated coding agents) applied to engineering productivity or domain solutions.

**Domain & Industry Experience**

* **Financial Services Experience:** Proven track record working within a Tier-1 investment bank, hedge fund, or major financial institution.
* **Asset Class Expertise:** Strong domain knowledge in **Commodities** (Power, Gas, Oil, Metals, Agriculture) or adjacent cross-asset products (**FX, Rates, Equities**).
* **Market Data Fundamentals:** Understanding of real-time market data structures, tick data, exchange connectivity, forward curves, volatilities, and reference data feeds.
  

  

**Mindset & Behavioral Attributes**

* **Self-Driven & High Ownership:** A true "go-getter" who takes proactive ownership of complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Exceptional communication skills with the ability to converse fluently with traders, MQA, risk managers, and technology leaders.
* **Problem-Solving & Agility:** Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-stakes Front Office environment where requirements evolve rapidly.
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred
  

  

**What we can offer you**

We work hard to have a positive financial and social impact on the communities we serve. In turn, we put our employees first and provide the best-in-class benefits they need to be well, live well and save well.

  
  

By joining Citi London, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:

* Generous holiday allowance starting at 27 days plus bank holidays; increasing with tenure
* A discretional annual performance related bonus
* Private medical insurance packages to suit your personal circumstances
* Employee Assistance Program
* Pension Plan
* Paid Parental Leave
* Special discounts for employees, family, and friends
* Access to an array of learning and development resources
  

  

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive.

  
  

**Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities.**

jobs.description:
Due to an expanding portfolio of design led projects throughout Ireland and Northern Ireland, Hall Black Douglas are seeking an experienced architect with proven design skills, a rigorous approach to technical detailing and the complementary contractual skills to successfully deliver the design intent on site.

The practice has developed its own sustainability guidelines over 25 years and is currently delivering EnerPHit Passive House on listed buildings for Queen's University and have successfully delivered multiple NZEB and BREEAM Excellent projects, with Ballycastle Leisure Centre opening in 2027 as the first operational Net Zero Swimming Pool in Ireland.

Health Insurance, Cycle to Work scheme, RIBA Pension scheme, flexible hours, and Continual Professional Development are available to all staff. jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Be part of a team assessing and driving achievement of program specific performance within Honeywell Global Product Engineering Services organization. Responsibilities will include MRB (Material Review Board) certification, Momentum Factory Support, DMAIC and Supplier support activities impacting the Honeywell Aerospace Yeovil Location and the sister divisions supporting that facility. In addition, you will work with Class II Design Authority for the Life support, engine bleed & environmental control, and hydraulic systems at Site for Phase 6 ECNs supporting ISC and will be leading the Engineering effort to release ECNs (Engineering Change Notifications). You will partner with world class engineer's supporting sites on day-to-day operations, product execution along the whole production pipeline and delivery to final customer, as well as drive improvements in engineering quality and productivity.

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
  
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

Control Systems develops the thermal and motion control systems that help aircraft take off, land safely and protect the people on board. With more than 10 million passengers per day flying on aircraft equipped with our products and more than 75% of commercial flights beginning with our engine start systems, Control Systems reaches farther across the aviation industry than most people realize.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Class II Delegated Design Authority for Phase 6 ECNs (Dwg changes in a production support environment); including Eng assessment, ECN generation, and coordination with Engineering teams for resolution to various Engineering actions driven by Factory support and supplier requests.
* Technical assessment execution and coordination with extended engineering teams for substantiation analysis such stress, alternate Material, dimensional variation, qualification and testing, engineering approval requirement execution etc. to ensure product integrity for both day-to-day operations support and supplier requesting Engineering actions.
* Technical customer interface for submitting approval packages for Dwg changes, this may require meetings, documentation preparation and coordination with various Customer support teams.
* Work closely with ISC Engineering/Manufacturing, Operations & Quality for insight on impact by engineering actions for prioritization on execution, this will be related to process or yield improvements requiring a dwg update or implementing into a dwg a root caused properly documented on RCA method.
* Work independently & effectively in a cross functional team’s approach.
* Integration with ISC effort events as well as agile projects to review proposed processing changes to ensure product integrity.

**Key Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering
* Minimum 2 years’ experience in engineering
* Experience in Design and Manufacturing.
* Understand different product lines in the Aerospace industry.
* Knowledge of design practices and qualification requirements.
* Create, support and enhance specific action plans.
* Experience working with Cross Functional Teams.

What we offer:
  
• Work for a well-known brand with a strong focus on innovation and growth.
  
• Join a dynamic team with professional development opportunities, where most leaders are promoted from within.
  
• Access to medical, vision, dental, and mental health benefits
  
• Benefit from share investment plan and pension scheme.
  
• Be part of a culture that fosters inclusion, diversity, and innovation.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Underwriting & Pricing
jobs.description:
**ABOUT HOMEPROTECT**

**Cover for Almost every Home**

We founded Homeprotect on a simple principle - to provide protection to people underserved by the home insurance industry. Since 2002, we've been combining smart technology with real human expertise to protect hundreds of thousands of unique homes across the UK, and we're just getting started.

If you're someone who loves solving interesting problems, taking ownership and working with a team that aims high, speaks up and lifts each other, Homeprotect is a place where you can do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real difference for our customers.

**What It's Like to Work Here**

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do our people. We're a small but perfectly formed team of insurance specialists, technologists, data scientists and customer champions - all bringing individual expertise, an appetite for innovation and a shared ambition to protect the homes and things people love.

We work at pace, but we trust our people to work in a way that brings out their best. You'll collaborate closely across teams, have real ownership from day one and see the impact you have first-hand with flexible working to help you balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life.

We've been recognised as a Great Place to Work UK for seven consecutive years - most recently ranked 29th nationally, jumping 71 places in a single year.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

Underwriting & Pricing decides which risks Homeprotect takes on and what we charge for them, one of the company's most strategically important and technically demanding domains, and one whose output, the price and terms of a quote, ripples through nearly every other part of the business: the journey that presents it to a customer, the policy created from it, and the numbers reported on afterwards.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to shape the technical direction of this domain as its platform modernises, and to work across the boundary with the teams that depend on it, so pricing and underwriting changes can be made quickly, safely and with confidence across the business, not just within one team's codebase. At this level, you'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, defining technical direction rather than executing someone else's, and your influence will extend beyond a single team: you'll be the person other engineering teams turn to when a change touches pricing, quoting or underwriting logic.

Success in this role means Underwriting & Pricing's architecture and technical standards let the business change pricing and risk logic quickly and safely, and that other teams depending on the domain can build against it with confidence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Technical Direction & Architecture**

* Define and own the technical direction and architecture for the Underwriting & Pricing domain: the pricing and rating engines, underwriting rules, risk appetite logic and quote calculation services.
* Make architectural decisions that affect multiple teams or systems, and document them clearly enough that others can act on them independently.
* Identify and drive the resolution of significant technical risk or complexity before it becomes a business problem, particularly around the accuracy and auditability of pricing and underwriting decisions.
* Lead the technical design of complex, cross-team initiatives from first principles through to delivery.

**Cross-Domain Technical Leadership**

* Act as the technical point of contact for other engineering teams whose systems depend on pricing, quoting or underwriting output.
* Influence architecture and engineering standards beyond the immediate team, helping the wider engineering organisation make sound decisions wherever they touch this domain.
* Represent Underwriting & Pricing in cross-team or organisation-wide technical discussions and decisions.

**Product & Business Partnership**

* Partner with the domain's Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and Actuarial and Commercial colleagues, to translate pricing and risk strategy into a technical direction that can support it.
* Help stakeholders understand technical trade-offs and constraints, and shape pragmatic solutions that balance commercial ambition with engineering rigour.

**Mentoring & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop senior engineers and emerging technical leaders within the team.
* Drive improvements to engineering practices, testing and operational rigour appropriate to a domain where correctness has a direct commercial consequence.
* Contribute to Homeprotect's wider engineering standards and architecture as the organisation's product engineering model matures.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

**Essential**

* Proven experience as a Staff Engineer or equivalent, owning technical direction across multiple teams, platforms or a significant business capability.
* Strong track record of defining architecture and engineering standards independently, and communicating them clearly through documentation, design and discussion.
* Experience influencing engineering decisions across teams without relying on formal authority.
* Comfortable working with rules-heavy, calculation-intensive systems, where correctness, auditability and rigorous testing matter as much as delivery speed.
* Strong hands-on experience in at least one modern backend language, such as C# or Java (or a comparable object-oriented language).
* Deep, hands-on understanding of modern software engineering practices: continuous integration and deployment, automated testing, observability and cloud-native development.
* Experience operating production systems, in a public cloud environment such as Azure or GCP, that need to be reliable, secure, performant and auditable.
* Excellent communication skills, able to build trust and drive alignment with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, including senior stakeholders.

**Desirable**

As a **Software Engineer** (known internally as an **Engineer**) at The Open University, you will contribute to the design, development, and support of high‑quality software solutions, working across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and system design through to coding, testing, and deployment.

In addition to building new functionality, you will support the services you develop, contributing to application monitoring, incident management, and ongoing improvements to reliability and performance.

Demonstrates effective use of AI-assisted development tools to enhance productivity, improve code quality, support testing and documentation, and enable faster delivery, while being mindful of governance, security, and cost considerations.

jobs.title: Senior Optical Measurement Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Azure Fiber is looking for a Senior Optical Measurement Systems Engineer to join our Metrology team. You will apply fundamental science to develop advanced measurement capabilities for optical fibre products, with particular relevance to hollow-core fibre and, where applicable, fibre-cable characterisation.

In this role, you will own significant measurement-system challenges from first principles through deployment. You will use fundamental physics and measurement science to explain the underlying optical behaviour, define what must be measured and establish methods that are both scientifically rigorous and practically useful. You will connect theoretical modelling with bench-top characterisation, then translate successful methods into robust, automated and fully productionised test systems. You will create clarity in technically ambiguous areas, make data-driven engineering decisions, and influence partners across research, product engineering, manufacturing and quality.  
  
This is a hands-on laboratory role requiring regular on-site work in our state-of-the-art Romsey facilities. You will build, align, automate, troubleshoot and validate optical systems while helping others adopt rigorous measurement practices.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead the architecture, development and validation of optical measurement systems for fibre and related products, with emphasis on hollow-core fibre and occasionally cable-level measurements.
* Apply fundamental science—including optics, materials science and measurement physics—to identify observable signatures, derive measurement principles and develop new characterisation methods for complex fibre systems.
* Translate physical models and measurement theory into test requirements, measurement methods, uncertainty budgets, calibration strategies, traceability plans and acceptance criteria.
* Bridge early theoretical and bench-top characterisation work to repeatable production test solutions, including optical and electronic hardware, instrument control, automation software, data pipelines, fixtures, safety controls and maintainability.
* Design experiments and interpret observations relevant to fibre characterisation, including attenuation, mode coupling and modal content, polarisation effects, interference and other light–matter interactions.
* Establish and maintain measurement-system-analysis practices, including gauge repeatability and reproducibility studies, correlation studies, reference artefacts, calibration controls, statistical process control and capability assessment.
* Apply control-systems fundamentals to sensing, actuation, feedback, stabilisation and automation, improving the performance and robustness of laboratory and production equipment.
* Drive technical investigations and root-cause analysis across relevant areas; communicate decisions and risks clearly, influence cross-functional partners, mentor engineers and improve shared engineering standards.

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Degree in Optical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.
* Understanding of optical-fibre characterisation, light-scattering and related optical phenomena, together with control-systems fundamentals and the ability to lead complex technical work across teams.
* Demonstrated ability to develop hands-on optical measurement or characterisation systems, including laboratory instrumentation, experiment design, automation and data analysis.

Other Requirements:

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role.
* These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  + Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience in characterising optical fibres (hollow-core fibres would be a plus), fibre components or optical cable, using techniques such as cutback, OTDR or backscatter, modal, polarisation, interferometric or imaging measurements.
* Experience in converting research or prototype test methods into production equipment with appropriate throughput, reliability, serviceability, safety, data integrity and operational controls.
* Programming and test-automation experience using tools such as Python, C# or equivalent, including instrument communications, data pipelines, analysis and visualisation.
