If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.

##### **Practical Information**

**Scope:** Full-time: 40 hours per week with initial 6 month probation period.  
**Location:** Office first, hybrid solution possible. You need to be eligible to work in Sweden.

##### **What we offer**

Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 100+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.

jobs.title: Commercial Solar PV Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Join Us**

Bord Gáis Energy has been powering the nation’s homes and businesses for 50 years. Today we are evolving from a utility supplier to a total energy solutions provider – combining trusted gas and electricity expertise with a growing portfolio of net zero products and services. We are at the forefront of Ireland’s energy transition strengthening energy security and helping customers moves to a low carbon future. Ardrar Ltd, recently acquired by Bord Gáis Energy (part of Centrica plc), is scaling rapidly as a leading provider of solar solutions across Ireland.

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth business, leveraging the strength of an established and trusted brand, Bord Gáis Energy, in the Irish market, backed by an international energy group (Centrica Plc).

**Your Team (Ardrar Ltd – A Bord Gáis Energy Company)**

Ardrar Ltd, part of the Bord Gáis Energy family, is one of Ireland’s fastest-growing providers of smart, sustainable energy solutions. We combine the agility of a rapidly scaling, technology-led business with the strength and reach of an established brand and energy leader in the Irish market

**Employment Terms**

This role is employed by Ardrar Ltd, which operates under separate terms and conditions to Bord Gáis Energy. Together we’re helping homes, farms and businesses cut costs, reduce emissions, and transition to cleaner energy.

**The Role**

We are seeking a **Commercial Solar PV Design Engineer** to support the next phase of transformation as we accelerate our transition to a more sustainable energy future. This role is central to our technical delivery, responsible for designing optimised, compliant, and cost-effective solar PV systems for commercial, industrial, and agricultural customers across Ireland.

You will work closely with our sales, project management, and installation teams to translate customer requirements and site conditions into engineered solutions that maximise energy yield, meet grid connection requirements, and align with project budgets and timelines.

**Core Responsibilities**

*System Design & Engineering*

* Design and develop detailed solar PV proposals for rooftop and ground-mounted commercial solar PV systems (typically 50 kWp to 5 MWp).
* Conduct virtual and physical site assessments to evaluate solar resources, perform shading analysis, and determine optimal system configuration.
* Create detailed technical reports including module layouts, string configurations, and array designs that maximise energy production while respecting structural, electrical, and fire safety constraints.
* Prepare single-line diagrams (SLDs), three-line diagrams, panel layouts, wiring diagrams, and earthing/lightning protection designs.
* Perform DC and AC cable sizing, voltage drop calculations, and protection device coordination.
* Select and specify major equipment including PV modules, inverters, mounting structures, combiner boxes, and balance of system components.
* Use industry-standard software (PVsyst, Helioscope, or equivalent) to perform energy yield simulations and estimate system production.
* Conduct shading and loss analysis, incorporating weather data, soiling assumptions, degradation rates, and system performance ratios.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*

* Provide technical support to the commercial sales team during the tender and proposal stage, including design, yield estimates, and equipment specifications.
* Create detailed pricing files including full Bill of Materials (BOM) for each project.
* Liaise with suppliers to get up to date pricing for materials.
* Work closely with project managers to resolve design-related RFIs, review contractor submittals, and support construction-phase engineering.
* Collaborate with structural and civil engineers on racking, foundation, and roof loading assessments for complex installations.
* Provide technical guidance to installation and commissioning teams, troubleshooting design or construction issues in the field.

*Technical Documentation & Compliance*

* Prepare engineering deliverables including stamped drawings, design specifications, equipment submittal and as-built drawings.
* Ensure all designs comply with Irish and EU standards, building regulations, ESB Networks grid connection requirements, and SEAI grant specifications.
* Support pre-install team by preparing technical documentation for ESB Networks and local authority planning submissions.

**Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering, Civil/Structural Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent relevant industry experience).
* Minimum 2–4 years' experience in commercial or utility-scale solar PV system design.
* Proficiency in solar design software such as PVsyst, Helioscope, Opensolar or equivalent.
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD or similar CAD software for producing construction-ready drawings.
* Solid understanding of solar PV technology, electrical systems, and grid interconnection requirements.
* Knowledge of Irish and EU electrical standards, building regulations, and ESB Networks grid connection processes.
* Experience preparing single-line diagrams, cable sizing calculations, and Bills of Materials.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Full clean driver's license (some site visits required).

**Why should you apply?**

This is your chance to shape Ireland’s clean energy future. You’ll work in a fast-growing business, collaborate with top talent, and accelerate your development every step of the way. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth business with the backing of a national energy leader with a trusted heritage brand, Bord Gáis Energy is part of Centrica plc, a leading international energy and services company. Benefit from the scale, investment, and expertise of the Bord Gáis Energy / Centrica Group.

Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: €55,000.00-€65,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Relevant: 1 year (required)

Work Location: In person

The HV Substations Delivery department in Networks Engineering, ESB Engineering & Major Projects is the centre of engineering design and project delivery for ESB’s Transmission & Distribution deliverables.

The Commissioning & SCS Teams in HV Substations Delivery verifies that the HV Substation equipment is fit for connection to the relevant HV system through the issue of a declaration of fitness certificate to the System Controller.

The Senior Commissioning Engineer will use their experience in Commissioning High voltage projects to deliver multi discipline projects and lead the development of commissioning standards and procedures, to modern international-best-practice. The Senior Commissioning Engineer will coordinate with various teams across HV Substations Delivery to optimize the delivery of HV projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead complex commissioning projects in high voltage substations, ensuring equipment meets all technical requirements before going into service.

* Perform and assess all on site testing associated with HV Commissioning

* Work with design specialists to resolve recurring technical issues and provide relevant training where required as well as manage quality of pre-commissioning activities to drive a quality culture within E&MP.

* Provide technical support, training, and advice to existing and new members of the commissioning & Design teams to develop their competency, leading mentor projects in process.

* Contribute to the development of work instructions and departmental procedures which are used by the wider commissioning team.

* Provide technical experience to review internal and contract designs, input and review de-commissioning documents and provide any technical advice required.

* Lead fault investigations, carry out detailed analysis and provide recommendations for improvement.

.

**Essential**

* Relevant HV Commissioning experience with full approval to issue Declarations of Fitness (DOF) to the system controller.

* A minimum of 5 years relevant experience in the High Voltage Transmission and Distribution industry

* Experience in testing High voltage primary plant and associated secondary equipment such as protection schemes

* Proven ability to work in a team to a high level of performance.

* A strong work ethic with a clear focus on delivery to ESB’s safety, time, quality, and cost objectives.

20th October 2026

The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland / UK prior to commencement of employment.

ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.

The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert in land remediation and hydrogeology, leading environmental site investigations, risk assessments and remediation programmes, while ensuring compliance with environmental legislation, regulatory requirements and industry best practice.

The Generation Engineering Delivery department in ESB Engineering and Major Projects leads engineering support for ESB’s generation business. The Generation Cables department is responsible for the design and project management of high voltage underground grid cable connections for large scale thermal and renewable generation projects including offshore wind projects

This role will act as the lead engineering authority for the onshore underground section of the export cable system connecting major ESB and JV offshore wind farms in Ireland and the UK to the onshore grid. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a **Senior Machine Learning Engineer** with strong software engineering fundamentals who can seamlessly integrate Machine Learning and GenAI capabilities into scalable, production-grade applications.

  

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer (10+ years) who enjoys building end‑to‑end systems—including front-end, back-end, APIs, and ML‑powered services—rather than doing research.

  

You will partner closely with ML researchers, data scientists, and platform teams to transform prototypes, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows into robust systems used across the enterprise.

  

**The Expertise We’re Looking For**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience (full stack, distributed systems, APIs, cloud).
* 4–6 years working with machine learning or GenAI systems in production environments.
* Experience designing and deploying RAG pipelines with embeddings and vector search.
* Hands-on with vector databases: FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, etc.
* Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen.
* Strong expertise in cloud-native engineering (AWS preferred).
* Proficient in modern front-end frameworks (React/Next.js, Angular, or similar) and in building robust web applications.
* Back-end development using Python (advanced) and one or more of: Node.js, Java, C#, or Go.
* Familiarity with traditional ML models, their applications, and how to integrate them into products.
* Cloud Platforms: AWS services such as S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS, SageMaker, API Gateway.
* Databases: Experience with relational systems (Oracle), cloud data warehouses (Snowflake), vector DBs, and knowledge graphs (Neo4j, RDF/SPARQL).
* DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of Responsible AI, data privacy, and ethical considerations in ML-driven systems.
* Good to have: Experience with model monitoring, evaluation frameworks, and automated alerting.
Ability to communicate architectural decisions and technical concepts to non-technical partners.  

  

**The Skills You Bring**

  

End-to-end engineering: You build full-stack applications that integrate ML/GenAI services seamlessly.

  

Productizing ML: Skilled at converting research notebooks and prototypes into production APIs, scalable microservices, or front‑end experiences.

  

System design & architecture: Comfortable with distributed systems, containerization, scaling, observability, and resilience.

  

ML/GenAI literacy: You understand how to select the right model type and integrate it appropriately into a business workflow.

  

Agentic workflows: Experience deploying multi-agent systems and monitoring their behavior in production.

  

Observability engineering: Hands-on with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and logging/metrics pipelines.

  

Engineering rigor: CI/CD, testing, version control, tracing, blue/green deployments, and secure coding practices.

  

Research & evaluation: Ability to evaluate new frameworks, GenAI tools, and emerging technologies for practical adoption.

  

Collaboration: Strong teamwork, mentorship, and communication, enabling strong cross-functional delivery.

  

**The Value You Deliver**

  

You build the full-stack components—APIs, UIs, services—that bring ML and GenAI capabilities directly into business applications.

  

You create scalable, secure, and reliable platforms for RAG, model serving, and agentic applications.

  

You improve engineering productivity by providing reusable patterns, libraries, and frameworks for ML integration.

  

You help the organization understand where different model types (LLMs, embeddings, classifiers, etc.) best fit business challenges.

  

You collaborate closely with ML researchers, product teams, and cloud engineering to deliver measurable business impact.

  

You elevate the team by sharing best practices in architecture, coding, and ML‑aware engineering

  

Click ' **Apply Now** ' to submit your resume or send directly to richard.riddett@cpl.ie

TV productions around the world run on software built in Bergen.

Live every day, from BBC News to Premier League.

Viz Trio is the graphics application used by newsrooms and sports broadcasters to create and put content on air, and we are growing the team that builds it.

We're looking for a senior engineer who is energized by hard systems problems and cares about building the right thing, not just shipping the next thing.

**The challenge**

Viz Trio is a large Delphi and C# application that has run live broadcasts around the world for more than two decades, and we are modernizing it while it stays on air.

That means:

* Re-engineering parts of a mature system built on technologies from different generations
* Improving Delphi/C# interop and carefully migrating selected Delphi code to C#
* Integrating new web-based UI components

This is the kind of problem most engineers never get to touch: deep, real, consequential, and visible on screen.

We want someone who finds that exciting rather than daunting.

**Who you are**

We care most about how you approach problems, but we also want a solid background.

We'd expect:

* You embrace AI-assisted development where it helps you move faster without compromising engineering quality
* A strong background and experience with a high-level object-oriented language like C#
* Experience with Delphi or interest in learning and working with the language
* Experience troubleshooting, maintaining, and safely evolving large long-lived desktop applications with complex legacy codebases
* Genuine care for architecture and system design, and the judgment to know when to modernize and when to leave well enough alone
* You raise the level of the people around you through mentoring, reviews, and sharing your technical experience
* Experience collaborating across teams and contributing to technical decision-making
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent skills and experience

**What you'll do**

* Work hands-on with Viz Trio's Delphi and C# codebase
* Apply AI-assisted tools where they improve speed without compromising quality
* Help determine what gets rewritten, what gets wrapped, and what's left unchanged
* Collaborate with the wider Trio team and stakeholders across Vizrt
* See your work on air, in real broadcasts, in real time

**Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Private health insurance, a competitive pension scheme
* Paid Time Off: Generous vacation days, sick leave, and public holidays to support a healthy work-life balance
* Professional Development: Opportunities for ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities
* Innovation Days (three per month) dedicated to experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement
* Modern office located in Media City Bergen
* Small, autonomous teams with shared ownership and fast, flat decisions

Join our team and take advantage of these benefits while working in a dynamic and supportive environment.

**Om bedriften**
----------------

Since 1997, Vizrt has empowered the world’s leading broadcasters and content creators - Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, CNN, BBC, Fox, CBS, Al Jazeera, and 100+ others - with cutting-edge visual storytelling technology.

We’re a global team of 600+ innovators across 17 countries, pushing the boundaries of graphics control, real-time graphics, cloud production, and broadcast automation.

Our office is located in Media City Bergen, Norway.

You will work alongside international colleagues in an environment where team spirit and work-life balance are taken seriously.

jobs.title: Data and Integration Architect at Plesner
jobs.description:
Kontakt

**Monika Lalevic Gabel**
------------------------

HR Manager

**Claus Egholm Nielsen**
------------------------

CIO

You will be responsible for the architecture. And you will help build the solutions that give our colleagues more time to focus on our clients’ matters. As a Data and Integration Architect at Plesner, you will take technical ownership of our data warehouse and integrations in Microsoft Azure. Client, matter and financial data must be easy to find and reliable. It must be possible to automate manual tasks and use AI in everyday work. You will lay the foundations for this in close collaboration with specialists in IT, finance and legal workflows.

**About the role**

Work is already under way. The new integration platform uses an event-driven architecture in Azure and is designed to accommodate the system changes planned for the coming years. The initial architectural decisions have been made, existing integrations have been mapped, and the first entities have been documented.

You will build on this work and take responsibility for developing the architecture further and turning it into operational solutions. Together with colleagues, management and external partners, you will draw up a prioritised plan for further development.

A d data foundation will provide better insight into clients and sectors, as well as a stronger basis for pricing and monitoring our matters.

**Your three main responsibilities:**

**Plesner’s own data foundation**

You will further develop the architecture and data models in our enterprise data warehouse (EDW) and plan a phased transition to bring more data processing and business logic into Plesner’s own environment. Our aim is to have control of our architecture, data models and code. Throughout the transition, you will ensure that critical data flows and reports continue to work, and collaborate with data owners on d definitions, data quality and secure access to data.

**Connecting our systems**

You will develop the integration platform’s API and event layers in .NET and build reusable integrations with our data warehouse and systems covering HR, finance, time recording, matter and document management, and identity, among other areas. Working with specialists in these areas, you will ensure that the integrations support their workflows.

You will help make data and functionality from our data warehouse and integration platform available to AI solutions, for example through Model Context Protocol (MCP). Together with colleagues, you will establish which needs the solutions should address and how to manage access and safeguard confidentiality.

You will migrate existing integrations from legacy, self-hosted environments to Azure and lead the integration work for upcoming system changes. Working with IT Operations, you will monitor and maintain existing PowerShell scripts, background services and scheduled jobs until they are replaced, ensuring that functionality is preserved.

**d development practices**

You will establish DataOps with CI/CD and d standards for development, testing, automated releases, error handling, monitoring and documentation. You will ensure that colleagues and external partners follow these standards and that their work meets the required quality standards. Changes must be controlled and traceable. You will ensure that confidential and sensitive data is handled correctly throughout the integration chain.

**About you**

You have experience in designing and developing data platforms and data warehouses based on Microsoft Azure. You are used to taking responsibility for architecture and technical decisions, and you take a hands-on role in implementation.

**Essential experience and skills:**

* solid experience with C# and both .NET Framework and modern .NET
* solid experience with SQL Server or comparable relational databases, as well as SQL, data modelling and ETL/ELT
* proficiency with the command line (CLI) and PowerShell
* experience in modernising or optimising existing solutions in self-hosted environments and managing background services and scheduled jobs on servers
* experience with system integration and APIs, and an understanding of event-driven integration
* experience with cloud-based data platforms in Microsoft Azure
* experience with CI/CD, version control and automated quality assurance for data solutions
* the ability to translate architectural principles into solutions and standards that others can work with.

**Desirable experience:**

* practical experience with REST, queues, webhooks and asynchronous processing
* experience with Azure App Service, API Management, Service Bus and Azure SQL
* experience with Azure DevOps and Infrastructure as Code
* experience in an organisation with stringent requirements for data security and confidentiality.

You ask how colleagues work before choosing a technical solution. You explain your choices, make the implications clear and your knowledge so that others can continue developing the solutions.

You are keen to try AI in your own work, for example to understand existing code and support development, testing and documentation. You critically assess the results and your experiences with colleagues.

**Your colleagues at Plesner**

You will join IT within Plesner’s Business Support function and report directly to our CIO, Claus Egholm Nielsen. Specialists in finance, CRM and legal workflows will contribute their requirements and expertise. You will work with IT Operations on monitoring and reliable operations, and with external development partners to develop solutions and build knowledge internally.

**How to apply**

We value diversity and encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

This is a permanent, full-time position based at Plesner in Copenhagen.

Please submit your application, CV and relevant supporting documents by **19 October**. We will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to fill the position once we have found the right candidate.

If you would like to learn more about the platforms, the architecture or how the team works together, please contact our CIO

Claus Egholm Nielsen at cen@plesner.com

We look forward to hearing from you.

Please send us your application in Danish. The employment interview will be conducted in Danish unless you are not a Danish speaker. In that case, you are welcome to submit your application in English.

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **Program Overview**

RDG (Risk Decision Group) provides nationwide background investigations compliant with national government standards to include support of continuous vetting for over 110 government agencies.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is seeking an experienced **AWS Cloud Security Engineer** to design, build, and operate security controls for a FedRAMP Moderate-authorized AWS cloud infrastructure supporting Peraton's RDG (Risk Decision Group) program. This is a hands-on role with a key part in day-to-day cloud security operations, embedding secure-by-design principles into cloud architecture, and maintaining continuous FedRAMP compliance.

The engineer is responsible for implementing security architecture, hardening cloud environments, maintaining continuous compliance monitoring, and supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience securing AWS environments within a federal compliance framework (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, RMF, or similar).

**This is a 100% remote position.**

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement security architecture for AWS workloads aligned with FedRAMP Moderate baseline controls
* Build and maintain security guardrails using AWS-native services (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF, Macie, Inspector)
* Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code security controls (Terraform/CloudFormation) with policy as code
* Support System Security Plans (SSPs), ATO activities, and POA&M remediation
* Perform continuous monitoring, vulnerability scanning, patch management tracking, and monthly/annual assessment support
* Configure and maintain centralized logging, SIEM integration, and audit trail retention per FedRAMP/NIST requirements
* Implement least-privilege IAM policies, service control policies (SCPs), and cross-account access controls.
* Manage encryption at rest and in transit (KMS, ACM, TLS enforcement) per FIPS 140-2/140-3 requirements where applicable
* Respond to security incidents, perform root cause analysis, and support cloud-specific incident response playbooks
* Collaborate with DevOps/Platform teams to embed security into CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps)
* Maintain documentation for control implementation statements, architecture diagrams, and audit evidence
* Support boundary definition and system categorization activities (FIPS 199) as required

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* US citizenship required; ability to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret eligible clearance
* Minimum 8 years work experience with BS/BA in computer science, or 10 years work experience with an AA/AS degree in Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5+ years of hands-on AWS engineering experience, with 3+ years specifically in cloud security roles
* Demonstrated experience working within a FedRAMP Moderate or FedRAMP High, DoD IL4/IL5, or equivalent federal compliance environment
* Experience supporting or maintaining an SSP and RMF processes
* Experience with AWS GovCloud (US), AWS Commercial, or equivalent federal AWS environments
* Strong hands-on expertise with AWS security services: IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF, Macie, Inspector, and Systems Manager
* Solid understanding of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control families (AC, AU, CM, IA, SC, SI, etc.) and the ability to map implementations to specific controls
* 3+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation), including security scanning and policy-as-code tools
* Networking security fundamentals: VPC design, security groups, NACLs, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, and network segmentation for compliance boundaries
* Experience with vulnerability management tools (AWS Inspector or similar) and remediation tracking
* Experience implementing Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) in AWS
* Familiarity with SIEM/log aggregation tools (Splunk, AWS CloudWatch, OpenSearch, or similar) for security event monitoring
* Scripting ability in Python or Bash for automating compliance checks and remediation
* Understanding of encryption standards relevant to federal systems (FIPS 140-2/140-3, TLS 1.2+)
* One of the following certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (with a security focus), or CISSP, CISM, or Security+ (with strong AWS hands-on experience).

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Direct experience supporting a Peraton program or similar federal integrator (Leidos, Booz Allen, SAIC, General Dynamics IT, etc.)
* Familiarity with server and systems hardening software
* Experience with container security (ECS/EKS), including image scanning (ECR scanning) and runtime protection
* Experience with AWS Control Tower and multi-account landing zone security governance
* Experience automating compliance evidence collection for continuous ATO (cATO)
* Prior experience with change management processes in a regulated/audited environment
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field
* Active security clearance
* Experience with AWS AI services (Amazon Bedrock)
* Experience with hybrid/multi-cloud architecture, including Azure (VNets, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure Policy, ExpressRoute)
* Experience with Microsoft .NET
* Experience supporting ATO/continuous monitoring processes
* Familiarity with DevSecOps pipelines
* Familiarity with AI security and governance frameworks, national security/defense/critical infrastructure missions, and supporting federal agencies or large GovCon programs

#RDG

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Extend and maintain the lab's VR testbed (Unity front-end, Python back-end) integrating live speech recognition, eye tracking, hand tracking, and a scene-graph representation of the task environment.
  
  
Implement an incremental multimodal reference resolver that fuses speech, gaze, and gesture into a continuously-updated belief distribution over candidate interpretations, meeting real-time latency requirements (less than 200ms end to end).
  
  
Design and implement a library of in-situ visual overlays that render the agent's belief in VR, and integrate them with the communication policy developed by the Co-PI's team.
  
  
Design, pilot, and run controlled lab user studies (between- and within-subjects, N≈24-48), including experiment scripting, instrumentation and logging of behavioural measures, participant recruitment and scheduling, and IRB documentation.
  
  
Analyse quantitative (ANOVA, trust-calibration and error measures) and qualitative (interview, think-aloud) study data, and co-author submissions to CHI, UIST, DIS, CSCW, or HRI.
  
  
Collect, annotate, and release an expanded public corpus of natural deictic instructions, including running elicitation sessions and maintaining the annotation scheme and documentation.
  
  
Other duties as assigned.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
Minimum Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or closely related disciplines from a reputable institution of higher learning; with particular focus on Human-Robot Interaction.
  
  
Minimum 1 year of relevant research experience in Human-Robot Interaction as a graduate student, research assistant or research engineer.
  
  
Proficiency in programming software/languages such as C# and Python, and the Unity environment is required.
  
  
Hands-on experience developing for VR head-mounted displays (e.g., Meta Quest, OpenXR), including eye- and hand-tracking input.
  
  
Experience integrating real-time multimodal input pipelines (speech recognition, gaze, gesture) and/or LLM/VLM APIs into interactive systems.
  
  
Proven track record and professional experience in interface prototyping, user experimental design.
  
  
Demonstrated experience and know-how on academic research, literature survey, and academic manuscript preparation.
  
  
Technical skills in designing robotic interaction techniques, driving robotic simulation studies, or robotic prototypes with novel interaction techniques for human-robot interaction.
  
  
Technical skills with respect to user research design, and statistical analysis, and qualitative data analysis.
  
  
Ability to break down complex problems and design effective solutions.
  
  
Innovating new approaches and thinking outside the box.
  
  
Applicants with research publications in the HCI or HRI area will be advantageous.
  
  
Ability to work cooperatively as part of a small, agile academic research team is essential.
  
  
Self-motivated individual who can work independently and collaboratively with team members.

**Responsibilities:**  
The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring software reliability, test automation, and continuous quality improvement across the software development lifecycle. Familiarity with cross-browser, cross-platform, and responsive UI testing.

Ability to design maintainable, scalable, and reusable test automation suites.

Experience working in agile development environments (Scrum, Kanban, XP).

Experience with containerized testing in Docker/Kubernetes environments.

jobs.description:
GenZero is an investment platform company focused on accelerating decarbonisation globally. Founded by Temasek, we seek to deliver positive climate impact alongside long-term sustainable financial returns by investing in opportunities with the potential to be nurtured into impactful and scalable solutions.  
  
Driven by a common purpose to decarbonise for future generations, we recognise the need for a holistic and integrated approach to achieve a net zero world. At GenZero, we adopt a flexible investment approach across three focus areas to drive climate impact: (i) nature-based solutions that help protect and restore our natural ecosystems while benefiting local communities and biodiversity; (ii) technology-based solutions that deliver deep decarbonisation impact; and (iii) carbon ecosystem enablers which refer to companies and solutions that support the development of an effective, efficient, and credible carbon ecosystem.  
  
For more information on GenZero, visit www.genzero.co.  
  
We are looking for a graduate hire to design, build, and scale AI-enabled workflows across the firm. This person will work independently to translate investment and business workflows into repeatable AI systems, documented prompt libraries, and agent-based automations, partnering directly with business units to design and implement solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with business units to understand workflows and pain points, to identify automation opportunities and design tailored AI-enabled systems
* Build and maintain a firm-wide prompt and workflow library, including clearly documented prompts, reusable templates, and standard operating guides
* Develop single-agent and multi-agent workflows for the investment process, including research, financial analysis, and internal reporting, using LLM APIs and function calling to move beyond prompting into working systems
* Support the setup and implementation of necessary infrastructure, such as databases, cloud hosting, or access controls, as required
* Gather structured feedback from users on AI implementation to refine the AI-enabled workflow
* Lead internal enablement and training sessions so teams can adopt AI tools effectively and responsibly
* Track usage, quality, accuracy, time savings, and other adoption metrics to assess ROI of AI initiatives
* Establish best practices for prompt design, human review, escalation paths, and safe deployment of AI-enabled workflows across the organisation

**Expected Deliverables**

* A well-organised, firm-wide library of high-quality prompts, templates, and workflow documentation
* A portfolio of deployed single-agent and multi-agent workflows in active use across the organisation
* Clear documentation showing how each workflow works, when to use it, and where human review is required
* Regular reporting on usage, adoption, output quality, and workflow impact
* Practical recommendations on which AI tools and models the firm should use for specific use cases
* Training materials and examples that help teams adopt AI in day-to-day work

**Requirements**

* Completed degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Finance, or a related field
* Demonstrated experience turning prompts into usable workflows, tools, or automations, through internships, projects, or personal builds
* Ability to work independently with business units to scope and design workflow solutions with limited oversight
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to create clear prompts, instructions, and user-facing documentation
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to map business processes and identify where AI can add value
* Comfort working across both technical and non-technical teams

**Preferred Experience**

* Coding ability in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages
* Familiarity with private equity and investment workflows
* Experience creating internal playbooks, training materials, or operational documentation

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is hands-on and structured: able to independently scope a workflow with a business unit, build it using LLM APIs, document it, and iterate based on feedback. They are curious about how work gets done inside an organisation and comfortable owning a project from design through deployment with minimal hand-holding.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

**nShift** is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

**About you**

You're an engineering leader who still enjoys being close to the code. You care about your people as much as about the product, and you're comfortable balancing delivery, quality, and team growth.

You are someone who:

* Builds and leads a high-performing team of developers and testers, with clear expectations and regular feedback
* Knows the status of every commitment the team has made, and acts early when something slips
* Holds a high bar for the team's work and your own, raised through clear expectations and direct feedback
* Communicates openly and clearly with the team, stakeholders, and management, including when the message is difficult
* Acts in the best interest of the company and the team when making tough decisions

**Purpose of role**

At nShift, the Engineering Manager's primary task is to lead, hold accountable, and deliver through a group of talented developers and testers, ensuring they thrive in a collaborative, high-performing environment.
  
You are part of the product trio together with the Product Manager and the Designer, aligning business goals, customer needs, and technical solutions. You are the team's voice to the wider organization and bring company priorities back to the team clearly and honestly.

**Your role includes:**

* Collaborating with the product trio to balance feature delivery with quality
* Supporting team development and maintaining a high-performing culture
* Communicating company goals and representing the team within the organization
* Owning delivery predictability and the team's say/do ratio, alongside technical excellence

**What you'll be doing**

**Technology**

* Ensure that daily work aligns with the tech vision, guiding principles, and minimum quality standards, including monitoring code quality through tools like SonarQube.
* Take part in design and architecture discussions, and review code regularly enough to have an informed view of quality and risk.
* Challenge estimates and technical approaches, drawing on your own engineering experience.
* Make sure that the technology managed by the team is resilient, secure, and up to date.
* Promote internal education, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing across platforms and teams.

**Process**

* Challenge your team to enhance their working methods, proactively addressing opportunities and obstacles with a critical mindset.
* Ensure that your team follows established processes, such as Kanban, Scrum and test management, in service of predictable delivery, and advocate for adopting best practices and tools.
* Own the team's delivery commitments. Track planned versus delivered work each sprint and quarter, report honestly on the gap, and drive corrective action.
* Identify blockers, dependencies and risks early, and resolve or escalate them before they affect delivery.

**People Management**

* Administer and oversee personal development plans, salary structures, and recruitment processes.
* Create opportunities for team members to stay motivated through mentorship, coaching, or delegating tasks to encourage professional growth.
* Set clear expectations for each engineer and manage performance against them, setting an example for your team to follow.
* Build and maintain a robust team with overlapping skills and knowledge, avoiding critical dependencies on single individuals.

**What you will bring**

This is a **hands-on management role**: you will know what your team is building, why it is late when it is late, and what you are doing about it. For our Data Exchange team, we are seeking candidates who embody the following characteristics:

**Technical Proficiency: A strong hands-on background in C# is required, with a proven history of technical expertise in software development**. Experience with front-end development frameworks is a plus, but not mandatory.

**Delivery Ownership:** A track record of teams that ship what they commit to, and comfort using metrics such as cycle time, sprint predictability, and say/do ratio to run the team.

**Professional:** You understand that it’s a part of a manager’s role to look out for the interest of the company, and you are prepared to manage difficult tasks with this in mind.

**Exacting Standards:** Maintaining high standards is vital as you consistently aim for excellence in both personal performance and the work produced by your team.

**Effective Communication:** Proficiency in both written and spoken English is essential for ensuring seamless communication within the team and with stakeholders.

**Requirements**

**The technologies this team uses are:**

* C#, .NET, .NET Core, React native, Vue.js
* PostgreSQL
* Docker, Bitbucket
* AWS, IaC
* SonarQube, JFrog

**Education and experience**

* BS degree in Computer Science or related field
* Minimum of 5 years as a hands-on engineer, plus 2-3 years of management experience

**Language Skills**

* Fluency in English is mandatory (written and spoken)

At nShift, we believe in embracing diversity in all forms and fostering an inclusive environment for everyone, which we believe is essential for our continued success. We're an equal opportunity employer, meaning all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity, or disability status.

**Senior Software Engineer**

  

**What this role is about?**

  

You will design, build and operate modern cloud-based systems on the Microsoft stack, with a focus on .NET, Azure and GitHub.

  

This role requires strong ownership across the full lifecycle: problem framing, system design, implementation, deployment and production operations. You’ll work on scalable, secure and maintainable systems, applying solid engineering fundamentals and using tools like GitHub Copilot pragmatically to accelerate delivery without compromising quality.

jobs.title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Buyer Safety Experience
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

“WARNING: Choking Hazard — small parts. Not for children under 3 years.”  
  
“WARNING: This product can expose you to chemicals including antimony trioxide, which are known to cause cancer or birth defects or other reproductive harm.”  
  
Have you ever seen these warning labels on popular and seemingly innocent products, such as fidget spinners or food containers? As the Buyer Safety Experience team for Amazon Retail worldwide, we aim to raise the bar when it comes to educating and empowering consumers about product safety. Our team is responsible for the complete end-to-end safety experience for buyers — from the warnings you see on the product detail pages (and how to turn them into useful, actionable information), to making safer product recommendations targeted to each individual consumer’s needs, to informing consumers of recalled products and preventing them from being delivered to their doorstep.  
  
As the founding engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience - Romania team, you’ll be able to build the groundwork and influence its direction for the years to come. Our work cuts across various disciplines — from delivering an awesome customer and brand experience via great UI/UX, to building massively scalable distributed systems to support the most high-traffic pages on Amazon worldwide, to analytical and feedback systems which give us data-driven customer insights, to using GenAI to enable Selling Partners and brands to keep customers safe and informed. If you have a passion for both consumer and business-facing applications, and are obsessed with customer experience, we want you!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
As the first Software Development Engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience team in Romania, you will hire and lead a brand new team, and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders worldwide across Program and Product. Your role will be heavily customer-obsessed, building solutions to ensure Amazon is Earth's safest place to shop.  
  
A day in the life  

* Hiring: Build a new team from scratch
* Deeply understand technical decisions, influence long-term architecture
* Define the team's yearly goals and long-term technical vision and charter, along with product and business stakeholders
* Work closely with international stakeholders across our VP-level Trustworthy Shopping Experience org, in addition to TPM and PM-T

  
Key job responsibilities  
As the first Software Development Engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience team in RO, you will hire and lead a new team, and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders worldwide across Program and Product. Your role will be heavily customer-obsessed, building solutions to ensure Amazon is Earth's safest place to shop.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
* Experience in development in the last 3 years

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
#### **Vos missions**

Great assignments await you with our key account clients in rich and varied environments

The client is looking for a **senior Enterprise Architect** to support the implementation and operationalization of a Group-wide Enterprise Architecture operating model within a complex, federated, multi-entity environment. The consultant will transform an approved target operating model into concrete governance practices, establish architecture decision processes, define standards and review mechanisms, and drive adoption across business and IT stakeholders. The role requires a highly pragmatic architect capable of creating structure, facilitating decisions, delivering quick results, and ensuring that governance translates into tangible implementation outcomes. The mission combines strategic architecture leadership, governance design, stakeholder alignment, architecture coaching, and operational execution.

Your missions:

* Own and drive the implementation of the approved Enterprise Architecture operating model.
* Establish and continuously improve the architecture governance framework across the organization.
* Operationalize the federated Target Operating Model for all architecture roles and entities.
* Provide a unified architecture vision across business and IT domains.
* Implement and facilitate Architecture Review Boards (ARB) and governance processes.
* Embed architecture practices into portfolio management, project delivery, product development, security, data, integration, and vendor selection processes.
* Define and implement architecture decision-making mechanisms and compliance processes.
* Develop reusable architecture practices, standards, principles, and reference architectures.
* Build and animate an Architecture Community and architecture working groups.
* Define KPIs and governance metrics to measure architecture adoption and effectiveness.
* Transfer knowledge and ensure long-term autonomy of internal stakeholders.
* Drive alignment between Group and local entities while maintaining delivery efficiency.
  

Your activities:

Enterprise Architecture Governance

* Translate the approved operating model into practical working methods.
* Create a prioritized implementation backlog.
* Define milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points and pilot initiatives.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, policies and reference architectures.
* Define and maintain governance workflows and decision processes.
* Ensure traceability of architectural decisions and escalation paths.

Architecture Review Board (ARB)

* Define ARB scope, participation model, quorum rules and governance processes.
* Organize and facilitate Architecture Review Board sessions.
* Prepare decision-ready architecture review packages.
* Record, track and communicate architectural decisions.
* Establish escalation mechanisms and governance controls.

Architecture Decision Management

* Implement Architecture Decision Records (ADR).
* Establish delegated decision rights and decision-routing mechanisms.
* Implement waiver and exception management processes.
* Define architecture compliance reviews and compliance levels.
* Create accelerated governance processes for urgent business needs.

Operating Model Implementation

* Clarify responsibilities, mandates and decision rights of:
  + Enterprise Architects
  + Domain Architects
  + Technical Architects
  + Solution Architects
* Define interactions, handovers and escalation paths between architecture roles.
* Support the rollout of the federated architecture model across entities.

Stakeholder Alignment

* Align business, product, delivery, engineering, infrastructure, security and data stakeholders.
* Facilitate architecture-driven decision-making.
* Build consensus around priorities, trade-offs and reusable solutions.
* Promote shared ownership across teams and entities.
* Communicate and defend the architecture vision at senior management level.

Architecture Integration into Delivery

* Integrate architecture within:
  + Portfolio management
  + Funding processes
  + Demand intake processes
  + Project delivery
  + Product delivery
  + Application lifecycle management
  + Security and risk management
  + Data and integration initiatives
  + Technology selection
  + Vendor selection

Architecture Framework & Artefacts

* Define the minimum viable architecture artefact framework.
* Establish ownership and approval processes.
* Define versioning standards.
* Implement review triggers.
* Define retirement and lifecycle management rules.
* Translate platform guardrails into actionable guidance for delivery teams.

Community & Capability Development

* Coach architectural communities and architecture stakeholders.
* Establish Architecture Communities of Practice.
* Lead focused architecture working groups.
* Deliver knowledge transfer activities.
* Enable internal teams to operate the governance model independently.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

* Define and monitor KPIs related to:
  + Architecture adoption
  + Decision effectiveness
  + Delivery enablement
  + Reuse
  + Compliance
  + Risk reduction
  + Stakeholder value
* Drive continuous improvement of governance practices.
* Foster momentum and accountability across teams.

You have the following skills:

Enterprise Architecture

* Enterprise Architecture (10+ years)
* Enterprise Architecture Governance
* Federated Architecture Operating Models
* Architecture Review Boards (ARB)
* Architecture Governance Frameworks
* Architecture Decision Records (ADR)
* Architecture Compliance Management
* Reference Architectures
* Enterprise Standards & Policies
* Architecture Service Models

Architecture Methodologies & Frameworks

* TOGAF
* ArchiMate
* Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
* ITIL

Governance & Decision Management

* Governance Design and Implementation
* Decision Traceability
* Delegated Decision Rights
* Waiver & Exception Management
* Compliance Reviews
* Risk Management
* Escalation Management

Stakeholder & Leadership Skills

* Executive Stakeholder Management
* Facilitation & Workshop Leadership
* Change Management
* Consensus Building
* Community Leadership
* Coaching & Mentoring
* Organizational Alignment
* Communication & Influencing Skills

Delivery & Transformation

* Agile Delivery Environments
* Portfolio & Demand Management
* Product Delivery
* Project Delivery
* Technology Selection
* Vendor Management
* Organizational Transformation

Technical & Domain Knowledge

* IT Infrastructure
* Security Architecture
* Data Architecture
* Integration Architecture
* Application Lifecycle Management
* Digital Platform Governance

Languages

* Fluent English (mandatory)
* French (nice-to-have)
* Dutch (nice-to-have)
* German (nice-to-have)

Nice-to-Have

* Experience in the Energy & Utilities sector
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering IT solutions in Agile environments
* Experience in multinational and multi-entity organizations
* Experience operating in federated governance environments

#### **Votre profil**

* If you are at least fluent in FR/ENG or NL/ENG it’s best

#### **Advantages**

* Group insurance

jobs.title: Design Engineer Infraworks
jobs.description:
**Design Engineer Infraworks**

Antwerpen, Gent, Hasselt of Brussel

  

Als **Design Engineer Infraworks** in onze **afdeling Infrastructures** draag je elke dag bij aan onze missie door een cruciale rol te spelen in het ontwerpen, modelleren en optimaliseren van complexe infrastructuurprojecten. Met behulp van geavanceerde softwaretools zoals Autodesk InfraWorks en Civil 3D creëer je innovatieve oplossingen voor wegen, rioleringssystemen en andere infrastructuren. Je **rapporteert aan** de **Competence Centre Manager BIM /CAD**.

  

Als Design Engineer is het mogelijk om vanuit onze kantoren in Antwerpen, Gent, Hasselt of Brussel te werken.

  

Klaar om het verschil te maken? Dan kijken we ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

  

**Wat wij bieden**

* Tractebel is meer dan een werkplek. Dit is jouw kans om te groeien aan de zijde van **topexperts** in **impactvolle projecten** wereldwijd. Deze omgeving is gebouwd op **teamgeest** waarin je je hoogste potentieel kunt bereiken. Het management steunt actief de ontwikkeling van zijn mensen en er zijn talloze mogelijkheden tot **groei** binnen de ENGIE Groep.

* Wij bieden een **competitief salarispakket**, inclusief representatievergoedingen, dubbel betaalde vakantiedagen, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, bonussen, hospitalisatieverzekering, pc-privéplan, ENGIE-aandelenopties en meer.

* Onze **mobiliteitsplannen** kunnen aangepast worden aan jouw behoeften: een bedrijfswagen, treinabonnement, leasefiets of combinaties hiervan ... Je kan je bedrijfswagen ook inruilen voor het flexibele en fiscaal gunstige **Belgische mobiliteitsbudget**!\*\*

* **Flexibele** hybride regelingen maken **telewerken** (2-3 dagen per week), werken op locatie of onderweg mogelijk. Via voordelige aankoopprogramma's en genereuze bijdragen aan je mobiele en internetabonnementen deelt Tractebel in de kosten van je thuiskantoor.

* Vakantie: 32 dagen. Je kunt ook 5 extra dagen kopen voor extra ontspanning.

* Om onze successen te vieren en plezier te maken komen we samen voor teamsporten, afterworks, teambuildingactiviteiten, ons jaarlijkse feest en veel meer.
  

**Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden**

* Ontwerpen en modelleren van infrastructuurprojecten:
  + Gebruik maken van InfraWorks en Civil 3D om ontwerpconcepten voor infrastructuur te visualiseren, simuleren en optimaliseren (wegen, spoorwegen, rioleringssystemen, etc.).
  + Analyseren van topografische, geospatiale en geotechnische gegevens voor het creëren van realistische en betrouwbare modellen.
  + Uitvoeren van dimensionering en berekeningen voor wegontwerpen, waterbeheer en andere infrastructuurnetwerken.
* Samenwerking met projectteams:
  + Nauw samenwerken met interne teams en externe stakeholders om ervoor te zorgen dat ontwerpen voldoen aan specificaties en lokale normen.
  + Coördineren met de ontwerp-, engineering- en constructieteams om de technische haalbaarheid van projecten te waarborgen.
* Analyseren van projectgegevens en simulaties uitvoeren:
  + Integreren van geografische gegevens en andere informatie uit terreinmetingen in BIM-modellen voor een efficiënter ontwerp- en bouwproces.
  + Gebruik maken van simulaties om de impact van het ontwerp te evalueren op milieu, kosten en tijd.
* Ondersteuning bij documentatie en rapporten:
  + Ondersteunen bij het opstellen van projectdocumentatie, rapporten en presentaties voor klanten en belanghebbenden.

**We horen graag van mensen met**

  

* Minimaal een bachelor in Civiele Techniek, Bouwkunde of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
* Uitgebreide ervaring met **Autodesk InfraWorks** en **Civil 3D.**
  + Autodesk InfraWorks: Gedetailleerd 3D-modelleren van infrastructuurprojecten en het uitvoeren van simulaties van realistische scenario’s.
  + Autodesk Civil 3D: Ontwerpen van wegen, analyse van rioleringssystemen en het beheren van topografische en geotechnische data.
  + BIM (Building Information Modeling): Bekwaamheid in het werken met BIM voor het optimaliseren van ontwerpprocessen en de samenwerking tussen verschillende teams.
* Grondige kennis van infrastructuurontwerp en -modellering.
  + Grondige kennis van **ontwerpprincipes voor hoofdwegen, primaire wegen en andere infrastructuurelementen.**
  + Ervaring in het ontwerpen en modelleren van rioleringssystemen, wegen en andere civiele infrastructuur.
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met het werken in teamverband.
* Probleemoplossend vermogen en oog voor detail.
  

**Ons rekruteringsproces**

* Pre-screeningsgesprek / diepgaand HR-interview (op locatie of via Teams) met de Talent Acquisition Partner
* 1 of 2 inhoudelijke interviews (bij voorkeur op locatie) met uw toekomstige manager
  

Onderzoek toont aan dat mannen solliciteren wanneer ze aan 60% van de vereisten voldoen, terwijl vrouwen pas solliciteren wanneer ze ervan overtuigd zijn dat ze aan 100% voldoen. Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden – we horen graag van je!

**Wie je bent**

* **Communicatievaardigheden**: Het vermogen om effectief en duidelijk te communiceren in het Nederlands met projectteams, klanten en andere belanghebbenden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
* **Samenwerken in teamverband**: Ervaring met het werken in een multidisciplinair team en het succesvol bereiken van gezamenlijke ontwerpdoelen.
* **Probleemoplossend vermogen**: Sterk analytisch denkvermogen en het vermogen om technische problemen snel te identificeren en op te lossen.
* **Oog voor detail:** Zorgvuldigheid en precisie in ontwerpwerkzaamheden, waarbij geen enkel detail over het hoofd wordt gezien.
* **Tijdbeheer en organisatie:** Het vermogen om meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te beheren en prioriteiten te stellen om deadlines te halen
  

**Wie we zijn**

Klaar om je positieve impact vorm te geven? Sluit je dan aan bij Tractebel, onderdeel van de **ENGIE Groep**, en onze 5600 gepassioneerde **experts** wereldwijd die zich iedere dag inzetten om te bouwen aan een **duurzamere wereld**. Draag bij aan koolstofneutraliteit in verschillende sectoren**, zoals kernenergie, hernieuwbare energie, gas en elektriciteit, elektriciteitsnetten, waterkrachtcentrales en stuwdammen, waterbeheer en -voorziening, ontzilting, complexe en hoogtechnologische gebouwen, transportinfrastructuren en havens en waterwegen.**

  

**Mensen, ethiek, veiligheid en duurzaamheid zijn onze topprioriteiten.** Met Tractebel verkeer je in een unieke positie om een positieve impact te maken op de wereldwijde net zero-doelstellingen. Als drijvende kracht achter deze doelstellingen zien we jou als onze grootste troef. **Onze mensen komen op de eerste plaats en diversiteit is onze kracht.** Diversiteit biedt immers nieuwe perspectieven die de drijvende kracht zijn achter prestaties en innovatie. Daarom verwelkomen we alle sollicitanten en blijven we ons inzetten voor een inclusieve werkplek.

  

Bij ENGIE, heeft elk talent een rol te spelen in het versnellen van de energietransitie. Maak het verschil en geniet van een verrijkende professionele ervaring. Ga interessante uitdagingen aan en bouw aan een carrièrepad dat weerspiegelt wie je bent.**Sluit je aan bij ons en maak deel uit van het avontuur van de eeuw!**

jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer im Bereich PKI & HSM (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Möchtest du die Zukunft unserer zentralen PKI- & HSM-Infrastrukturen aktiv mitgestalten? In einer Zeit, in der kontinuierliche Authentifizierung, Integritätssicherung und Datensicherheit von entscheidender Bedeutung sind, hast du die Möglichkeit, die aktuellen Infrastrukturen, IT-Systeme (Plattformen und Applikationen) aktiv zu betreiben, zu warten und diesen Bereich massgeblich weiterzuentwickeln. Dafür suchen wir dich als engagierten und motivierten DevSecOps Engineer (m/w/d) im Bereich PKI & HSM. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Betrieb und der Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Systeme mit Fokus auf Hardware Security Modules (HSM), Public Key Infrastrukturen (PKI) und weiteren relevanten Applikationen.

Deine Aufgaben

* Betrieb, Wartung und Weiterentwicklung der Systeme im Bereich PKI & HSM. Dazu gehören unter anderem HSM, PKI-Systeme, Credential Management Systeme (Smartcards, Hardware-Tokens) sowie Systeme für das Secret Management.
* Implementierung und Optimierung der Lösungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Product Ownern.
* Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Sicherheit der IT-Systeme durch Monitoring, Troubleshooting und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen.
* Automatisierung und Modernisierung von zentralen Systemen sowie deren Prozessen.
* Unterstützung bei der Anbindung neuer IT-Systeme an die PKI & HSM Infrastrukturen sowie bei der Analyse von Fehlern und der Behebung von Problemen.
* Mitgestalten einer langfristig belastbaren PKI, welche den heutigen und den bereits absehbaren Anforderungen gerecht werden kann.
* Enge Zusammenarbeit im DevOps-Team und dem Fachbereich in einer agilen Methodik (SAFe), um die Anforderungen an die IT-Systeme optimal umzusetzen und die Systemlandschaft gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.

Dein Profil

* Du hast eine abgeschlossene höhere Ausbildung in Informatik (FH, ETH, Uni) oder eine gleichwertige Weiterbildung.
* Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen PKI & HSM Engineering sowie Key und Certificate Management und/oder Secret und Credential Management, idealerweise in einem regulierten Umfeld.
* Ebenfalls verfügst du über fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Thales Network HSMs, Microsoft ADCS, .Net Entwicklung und Powershell.
* Du weist ein umfassendes Verständnis von PKI sowie der zugrundeliegenden Kryptografie aus und besitzt praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb moderner Lösungen, die die Anforderungen von On-premise-, Cloud- und SaaS-Systemen erfüllen.
* Deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, dein analytisches Denkvermögen und deine ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zeichnen dich aus.
* Du besitzt sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch.

Unser Angebot

* Fachlich- oder persönliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und einen Aufgabenbereich, der dir die Chance gibt, eigenverantwortlich deine Themen weiterzubringen
* Möglichkeiten Teilzeit zu arbeiten, Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, mobiles und flexibles Arbeiten sowie unbezahltem Urlaub
* Attraktive Zusatzleistungen und Vorsorgeleistungen weit über dem gesetzlichen Minimum
* Ein attraktives Gesamtpaket u.a. mit interessanten Nebenleistungen und Mitarbeitervergünstigungen (Sport, Freizeit, Kinderbetreuung, Krankenkasse)
* Lebe mit uns #mehrkönnen und #ITmadeinChreis5 – deine Kolleg:innen und Stakeholder sitzen alle im selben Haus, im Home Office oder im Haus über die Strasse – ohne Zeitunterschied

Für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

* **Brief description of the department’s mission** :

  

The selected candidate will join the TADYX1 Team in charge of managing the disciplines of electromagnetic protection for aircraft structures and systems and antenna integration.

The candidate will be part of multicultural and multidisciplinary team working in different military programs under our product portfolio, reinforcing the team in or der to ensure the implementation of complex design solutions within different challenging military projects, covering all the complete development V cycle: from customer/airworthiness requirements capture to aircraft certification, aircraft delivery and in-service aircraft support.

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:

  

*-* **Education:**

Degree in Telecommunication Engineering, Aeronautical, Electrical Engineering or Physics

* **Experience:**

At least 5 years in Engineering with strong background in electromagnetism theory, electromagnetic protection measures applied to aircraft structures and systems/equipment and aircraft design.

Knowledge about integration at platform level (complete cycle: specification, validation, verification, certification/qualification).

User of complex and advanced tools for electromagnetic simulation and modelling for EME design and antenna integration (CST, FEKO, etc,..). CAD management, computational tools and postprocessing.

Good Technical skills, familiar with R/T and R&D projects.

Ability to work autonomously as well as being active part of a team.

Ability to overcome difficulties in the development of the projects.

Knowledge of applicable standard and regulation for EME equipment qualification and aircraft certification (e.g. DO-160, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, CS/FAR25, etc,…).

jobs.title: Azure Backend Engineer – Cloud Native & AI-Assisted Development
jobs.description:
**¿Te unes al reto?**

En BIP – xTech estamos buscando a gente con ganas de crecer, aprender y enfrentarse a proyectos tecnológicos de verdad: cloud, datos, IA, seguridad, automatización, DevSecOps, IoT, Industria 4.0… ¡Aquí no te vas a aburrir!

Somos un equipo diverso y con muchas ganas, donde combinamos tecnología con estrategia para ofrecer soluciones top a nuestros clientes. Si te interesa estar en el centro de la transformación digital y construir soluciones cloud modernas sobre Azure, este es tu sitio.

**¿Qué harás?**

La forma de desarrollar software está cambiando. Herramientas como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code y otros asistentes de IA permiten acelerar enormemente el desarrollo, pero seguimos necesitando buenos ingenieros capaces de diseñar la solución, tomar decisiones técnicas, integrar sistemas y garantizar que el código generado sea mantenible, seguro y esté preparado para producción.

Ahí entras tú.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia sólida en desarrollo backend con .NET y Azure, acostumbrada a construir APIs, microservicios e integraciones cloud-native.

Trabajarás en soluciones donde Azure es una parte fundamental de la arquitectura, utilizando servicios como AKS, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault o Application Insights, entre otros.

Y queremos que la IA forme parte de tu forma habitual de desarrollar: desde generar y refactorizar código hasta crear tests, documentación, revisar implementaciones o acelerar la resolución de problemas.

**✅** **Lo que necesitamos de ti**

Imprescindible tener al menos 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend con .NET, con especial foco en:

* Desarrollo .NET / C#: experiencia sólida con .NET moderno, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, Dependency Injection, configuración, logging y gestión de errores.

* Diseño y desarrollo de APIs REST, incluyendo definición de contratos, versionado, autenticación/autorización, validación y documentación con OpenAPI/Swagger.

* Arquitecturas de microservicios: diseño de servicios desacoplados, comunicación síncrona y asíncrona, resiliencia, observabilidad y gestión de errores.

* Azure Functions: desarrollo de funciones HTTP, event-driven y background processing, incluyendo triggers y bindings.

* Integración en Azure: experiencia trabajando con servicios como Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid y Storage Queues/Blob Storage para construir arquitecturas orientadas a eventos e integración entre sistemas.

* Azure Key Vault y gestión segura de secretos, certificados y configuración sensible.

* Conocimiento de Managed Identities, Entra ID y OAuth2/OIDC para autenticación entre aplicaciones y servicios Azure.

* Experiencia trabajando con SQL Server / Azure SQL y acceso a datos desde .NET, idealmente utilizando Entity Framework Core.

* Conocimientos de Docker y containerización de aplicaciones .NET.

* Experiencia trabajando con Git y procesos de CI/CD, entendiendo cómo una aplicación pasa desde el código hasta los diferentes entornos.

* Experiencia real utilizando asistentes de desarrollo basados en IA, como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code o herramientas similares, no sólo para autocompletar código, sino como parte habitual del ciclo de desarrollo.

Esperamos que seas capaz de utilizar IA para generar, revisar, refactorizar, documentar y testear código, manteniendo siempre criterio técnico sobre lo que genera.

**Nos suma mucho si además:**

* Has trabajado con arquitecturas event-driven y patrones como Pub/Sub, queues, topics o asynchronous processing.

* Experiencia desplegando o desarrollando aplicaciones que se ejecutan sobre Kubernetes, trabajando con containers, configuración, secrets, health checks, scaling y troubleshooting básico.

* Conoces patrones de diseño de microservicios como API Gateway, Circuit Breaker, Retry, Outbox, Saga o CQRS.

* Tienes experiencia con Azure Container Apps además de AKS.

* Has trabajado con Application Insights, Azure Monitor y Log Analytics para observabilidad y troubleshooting.

* Conocimientos de Azure API Management (APIM): publicación y consumo de APIs, policies, seguridad, versionado y gestión del ciclo de vida de las APIs.

* Conoces Redis / Azure Managed Redis y estrategias de caching.

* Has trabajado con Cosmos DB u otras bases de datos NoSQL.

* Entiendes conceptos de Infrastructure as Code, especialmente Terraform, aunque no esperamos que seas especialista.

* Has trabajado con Azure DevOps o GitHub Actions para CI/CD.

* Tienes experiencia escribiendo tests unitarios, de integración y contract tests.

* Has utilizado herramientas como SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk o similares para mejorar la calidad y seguridad del código.

* Has trabajado con Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry, Semantic Kernel o integración de modelos de IA dentro de aplicaciones.

* Has trabajado con MCP, agentes de desarrollo, skills, instrucciones de repositorio o workflows agentic para mejorar el contexto que reciben las herramientas de IA durante el desarrollo.

* Tienes formación técnica (Informática, Telecomunicaciones, etc.).

* Te manejas bien en inglés.

* Tienes alguna certificación oficial de Microsoft Azure.

**¿Qué valoramos?**

* Mentalidad de ingeniería: no buscamos únicamente a alguien que programe historias de usuario, sino que entienda cómo encaja su código dentro de la arquitectura completa.

* Capacidad para diseñar soluciones simples, mantenibles y preparadas para producción.

* Criterio para decidir cuándo utilizar un microservicio, una Function, una Logic App o cualquier otro servicio de Azure.

* Entender que la IA acelera el desarrollo, pero no sustituye el criterio técnico.

* Capacidad para revisar críticamente el código generado por herramientas de IA y detectar problemas de arquitectura, seguridad, rendimiento o mantenibilidad.

* Mentalidad API-first y cloud-native.

* Buenas prácticas de desarrollo: clean code, testing, observabilidad y seguridad desde el diseño.

* Ganas de aportar, trabajar en equipo y seguir aprendiendo.

* Responsabilidad con tu trabajo y compromiso con el equipo.

* Curiosidad por cómo la IA generativa y los agentes están transformando el ciclo de desarrollo de software.

**¿Por qué unirte a BIP?**

* Personas primero: valoramos tu talento y tu equilibrio personal.

* Entorno ágil y flexible: trabajamos en remoto y con horarios que se adaptan a ti.

* Formación continua: tendrás acceso a cursos top en tecnología e innovación.

* Proyectos con impacto: trabajarás con empresas líderes construyendo plataformas, APIs, microservicios e integraciones sobre Azure.

* Desarrollo aumentado por IA: queremos que herramientas como GitHub Copilot o Claude Code formen parte de tu día a día y que nos ayudes a evolucionar nuestra forma de desarrollar software.

* Un equipo que suma: buen ambiente, colaboración real y cero postureo.

**¿Y ahora qué?**

Si te interesa, mándanos tu CV. Lo revisaremos con cariño y si encajas, te contactaremos.
