You will work closely with data engineers, analysts, architects, software developers, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality data products that enable data-driven decision making. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in the Databricks Lakehouse Platform, modern cloud-based data architectures, and data engineering best practices. Experience with .NET/C# development is highly desirable and will support seamless integration between enterprise applications and modern data platforms.

This is an excellent opportunity for a data professional who enjoys solving complex business challenges, building scalable solutions, and contributing to the evolution of a modern analytics ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient data pipelines using Databricks and cloud-native technologies.
* Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured datasets.
* Develop robust data models, data quality frameworks, and monitoring solutions to ensure platform reliability.
* Support advanced analytics, machine learning, AI initiatives, and enterprise reporting through high-quality data products.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Troubleshoot data platform issues, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement effective resolutions.
* Contribute to CI/CD processes, automation initiatives, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Ensure adherence to data governance, security, compliance, and operational best practices.

* Strong experience developing data pipelines using Python, Spark, and PySpark.
* Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Contributing to the organization's long-term modern data and analytics strategy.

You will have the opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies, large-scale datasets, and cutting-edge analytics solutions in a collaborative and innovative environment. jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

IT systems that work effectively keep Amazon’s operations running at full speed. Our IT Support Engineers work behind the scenes to troubleshoot any issues and improve our systems, so that we can operate at our best. Your focus will be to make sure our IT infrastructure is up to the demands of our global business. At the same time, you’ll get to work with the latest technology and learn from leaders who are creating the warehouse environments of the future.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Support end-user equipment and your building’s IT infrastructure
* Help with key network projects, like the IT setup of new Amazon buildings
* Suggest new processes that improve the way Amazon uses IT in its operational sites
* Train and mentor IT technicians

  
A day in the life  
You’ll be based on site and will travel to other operational sites in your country, and potentially internationally, several times a month. As an IT Support Engineer, you’ll work with remote and on-site colleagues to support them with any issues. You’ll use your expertise to make sure our platforms are working at their best, often implementing projects to maintain or improve our IT infrastructure. In some cases, you may also help design the infrastructure for new buildings and make sure everything is working for the site launch.  
  
About the team  
Ops Tech Solutions (OTS) is the field IT organization responsible for first level troubleshoot of IT issues in our FCs, distribution centers and other sites.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis
* Experience working in complex IT environments or equivalent
* Knowledge of IP networking fundamentals and extensive experience in the application of IP protocols
* Experience in network and operating system support
* Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish and English at C1 level or above
* Valid EU driver's license

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing operations environment
* Experience working in a customer-facing environment
* Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment
* certification in an applicable field like A+, Net+, Sec+, CCNA, LPIC, Linux+, AWS certification
* Experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP, or experience in software development and experience in managing and troublshooting network

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Engineering Manager (Core)
jobs.description:
At **Ocean Infinity**, we're on a bold mission to subsea data using innovative technology.

Using cutting-edge robotics, autonomous technology and world-class software, we're transforming how complex operations are carried out at sea. Our uncrewed systems are making ocean exploration and operations **safer, smarter and more sustainable**, helping unlock the vast potential of our oceans while reducing environmental impact.

This isn't a vision for the future. **It's happening right now.**

As we continue to push the boundaries of innovation and redefine what's possible in the maritime industry, we're looking for exceptional talent to join our fast-growing team.

Ocean Infinity is looking for an Engineering Manager to own the people, organisational capability and engineering capacity of a group of engineers within our Core Engineering team ( C#/.NET **or** Node/TypeScript). This is a senior people-leadership role: rather than owning the technical architecture or product priority, your role is to make sure the engineers in your group are well managed, performing to the best of their abilities, and developed and deployed against the organisation’s priorities.

You’ll work closely with team leads to keep technical leadership and people management aligned as the engineering group grows, and hold responsibility for building a scalable engineering team.

 **Requirements**

**What you will do!**

* Line-manage a group of engineers: run regular 1:1s, give feedback, and own their career development.
* Own performance management, recognition and reward for your engineers.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding and retention across your group.
* Own capacity and resource planning – decide where engineering resource is deployed and flag constraints early.
* Work with engineers to allocate them to projects, and manage workload to ensure projects can be delivered on time and with a high level of quality.
* Work with the product team and other team leads to resolve resource constraints and balance competing demands for capacity.
* Build the succession and technical leadership pipeline within your group, and identify capability gaps before they affect the team.
* Protect team health, engagement and working environment, and escalate organisational, staffing or performance issues that threaten delivery.

**What we look for!**

* Several years’ experience managing and developing software engineers, ideally within a scaling engineering organisation.
* A track record of hiring, retaining and developing engineering talent, including into more senior or lead roles.
* Comfortable balancing competing demands for engineering capacity across multiple concurrent projects or squads.
* Strong 1:1, coaching and feedback skills, with the judgement to handle performance issues fairly and directly.
* Enough technical credibility in engineering to earn the trust of the engineers you manage – you don’t need to own the technology, but you need to know how it works.
* Comfortable with capacity/resource planning and making trade-off calls under constraint.
* Genuine care for people’s development, combined with the willingness to have hard conversations about performance.

**Nice to have! ✨**

* Experience managing distributed or multi-location teams.
* Previous experience in marine, defence, or aerospace.

  
**Benefits**

***\*Salary: London up to £135,000 / Porto up to 95,000 EUR Per Annum\****

jobs.title: Domain Engineer
jobs.description:
**Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.**
  
  
Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.
  
  
**Part of something bigger**
  
Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.
  
Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.
  
We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.
  
  
**Your hiring experience matters**
  
Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.
  
If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

**The ERP Engineering Team at Shine**
-------------------------------------

We're a fast-growing engineering team on a mission to build the best ERP for Small Businesses in Europe. We work in a domain-based structure, where each domain has real ownership over its area — from architecture to quality and technical roadmap.

**Your Role as a Domain Engineer**
----------------------------------

As a Domain Engineer, you're the technical reference for the product: you define architecture direction, ensure engineering standards, and work closely with team managers and Senior Engineers to make sure technical decisions serve the business goals. This is a senior IC role, focused on cross-cutting technical impact, not people management.
  
We're modernizing our stack and expanding into new markets, which means real problems around scale, multi-tenancy, and domain complexity — not greenfield, but not paralyzing legacy either.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the target architecture of your domain and the realistic path to get there.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, security, and compliance are design constraints from day one, not afterthoughts.
* Maintain living architecture documentation (C4 model diagrams, ADRs) as part of the engineering workflow.
* Set and calibrate design review thresholds, delegating to senior engineers as their judgment grows.
* Spend roughly half your time embedded with engineering teams, and half on cross-engineering work — standards, the Golden Path, and the Architecture Forum.
* Grow the architectural judgment of senior engineers, so fewer decisions need to come through you over time.
* Partner with Engineering Directors, Engineering Managers, and Product to surface technical constraints and trade-offs with clarity.

**Job located in Porto with possibility of two remote working days per week.**

**About you**
-------------

* **Scalable systems experience:** You have significant hands-on experience designing and evolving systems at scale, ideally within multi-tenant SaaS or platform environments.
* **Architectural ownership:** You take end-to-end ownership of architecture decisions. You ensure your reasoning is well-documented so others can easily understand the context and trade-offs later.
* **Influence without authority:** You are comfortable operating with technical authority and guiding direction without needing formal line-management authority.
* **Cross-functional communication:** You can translate complex technical trade-offs into clear, legible concepts for Product managers and business leadership.
* **Empowerment over centralization:** You have a genuine interest in developing other engineers' judgment rather than centralizing decision-making around yourself.
* **Tech stack & domain experience:** You are comfortable with .NET, Angular, SQL Server, Azure, and modern CI/CD practices. Experience with financial, accounting, or ERP systems—as well as European regulatory compliance—is a strong differentiator.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

**Our recruitment process**
---------------------------

1️⃣ A 45' first call with Marc (Talent Acquisition Specialist) to get to know you better and share more about Ageras.

2️⃣ A 90' Technical Interview with one of our Domain Engineers to dive into Architecture and Coding topics

3️⃣ A 45' Manager interview with Rui (Senior Engineering Manager) to dive deeper into our set up.

4️⃣ A 60' Practical Assessment with one of our Domain Engineer.

new_jobs.title: Transit architect
new_jobs.description:
Als Arcadiaan help je bij het leveren van toonaangevende ontwerp-, engineering- en adviesdiensten. Je maakt deel uit van onze wereldwijde organisatie met 34.000 mensen in ruim 30 landen die zich inzetten om onze passie ‘improving quality of life’ ook echt tot leven te brengen. Iedereen speelt een belangrijke rol. Met de denkkracht van onze mensen in combinatie met technologie werken we aan het oplossen van ’s werelds meest complexe uitdagingen en maken samen het verschil.

Architectuur is overal om ons heen. De gebouwde omgeving bepaalt in grote mate de wereld waarin we leven. De architecten van Arcadis verrijken deze complexe leefomgeving met integrale en duurzame ontwerpoplossingen. Samen met onze klanten werken we aan projecten die een blijvende positieve impact hebben op huidige én toekomstige generaties.  
  
**Rolbeschrijving:**  
Als (medior) architect binnen Transit Architecture maak je deel uit van multidisciplinaire projectteams en geef je vorm aan een duurzame leefomgeving. Je werkt aan projecten door heel Nederland en mogelijk ook daarbuiten. Je weet jouw visie helder te verwoorden, te verbeelden en te vertalen naar kwalitatieve en haalbare oplossingen. Je analyseert de vraag van de klant en brengt samen met stakeholders de eisen en wensen in kaart. Vervolgens ontwikkel je samen met ervaren architecten een conceptontwerp, werk je dit technisch verder uit en breng je het visueel tot leven. Je werkt aan de renovatie en nieuwbouw van trein- en metrostations, maar ook aan uiteenlopende ontwerpopgaven zoals cultureel erfgoed, binnenstedelijke gebiedsontwikkelingen, multifunctionele gebouwen en de ruimtelijke inpassing en vormgeving van bruggen, tunnels en andere infrastructurele kunstwerken.

**Servicea area group Transit Architecture:**  
Binnen Transit Architecture bundelen we onze expertise op het gebied van trein- en metrostations. De groep bestaat uit architecten, bouwkundige ontwerpers en civieltechnische ontwerpers die samenwerken aan toonaangevende projecten in binnen- en buitenland. De afdeling telt circa 45 collega's, waaronder projectmanagers, projectbeheersers, technisch managers, contractspecialisten en ontwerpers. Het team kenmerkt zich door een sterke samenwerking, een informele sfeer en een gedeelde passie voor de gebouwde omgeving. Bij Arcadis hebben we vrijwel alle benodigde disciplines in huis. Daardoor kunnen we specialisten op het gebied van duurzaamheid, installatietechniek, landschapsarchitectuur, spoorinfrastructuur en vele andere vakgebieden direct aan projecten verbinden. Deze integrale aanpak stelt ons in staat om complexe ontwerpvraagstukken succesvol op te lossen en een breed scala aan projecten te realiseren. Amersfoort is onze thuisbasis, terwijl collega's daarnaast samenwerken vanuit de hub in Rotterdam.  
  
**Rolverantwoordelijkheden:**

* Je beheert zelfstandig (deel)projecten en zorgt ervoor dat deze worden gerealiseerd binnen de afgesproken planning, kwaliteit en financiële kaders;
* Je ontwikkelt architectonische ontwerpoplossingen en werkt deze uit in tekeningen, rapportages en andere projectdocumentatie;
* Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, projectleiders en multidisciplinaire teams om integrale en kwalitatieve oplossingen te realiseren;
* Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van ontwerpen en zorgt voor naleving van relevante wet- en regelgeving, normen en Arcadis-richtlijnen;
Je begeleidt en coacht junior collega's en draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en de ontwikkeling van het team.  

**Kwalificaties & Ervaring:**

* Afgeronde opleiding Architectuur aan een Technische Universiteit of Academie van Bouwkunst;
* Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring als architect;
* Ervaring met het begeleiden en ondersteunen van junior collega's in hun vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling;
* Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Je voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waarin ontwerp, techniek en stakeholdermanagement samenkomen. Kennis van ontwerpsoftware zoals Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp en Adobe Creative Suite is geen must maar waardevol, net als jouw inschrijving in het Architectenregister. Bij Arcadis werken we wereldwijd. Afhankelijk van je ambitie bieden we jou dan ook graag de mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan internationale projecten.  
  
**Vervolg je carrière als Arcadiaan:**  
We bereiken onze doelen door iedereen in staat te stellen het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wij geloven dat ieders bijdrage ertoe doet. Daarom pionieren we met een aanpak gebaseerd op jouw vaardigheden. Met jouw unieke ervaring en expertise stippel je zo je eigen carrièrepad uit. Samen maximaliseren we de impact! Jouw werk maakt het verschil. Waar je volgende rol bij Arcadis je ook brengt, je helpt duurzame oplossingen te bieden voor een gezondere planeet. Je drukt jouw stempel op je eigen carrière, je collega's, klanten, je leven en de wereld om je heen.  
  
**Together, we can create a lasting legacy:**  
Onze inzet voor gelijkheid, diversiteit, inclusie en erbij horen:  
We willen dat je elke dag je beste zelf kunt zijn. Gelijkheid en inclusie nemen we heel serieus en we houden onszelf verantwoordelijk voor onze acties. We willen een voorkeurswerkgever zijn en bieden iedereen een geweldige werkplek.

**Contactinformatie:**  
Wij ontvangen graag jouw CV en motivatiebrief via de Apply-button. Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact op met Femke van Viegen of TA- collega Jasper Kunstt.

* **Erstklassige Vor-Ort-Bedingungen:** Dich erwartet ein moderner, ergonomisch und klimatisiert eingerichteter Arbeitsplatz mit High-End-Hardware.

* **Flexible Arbeitszeiten:** Dank unseres Gleitzeitmodells bei geregelten Strukturen kannst du deinen Feierabend verlässlich planen.
* **Sicherheit & Entwicklung:** Freue dich auf einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit langfristiger Perspektive und Entwicklungschancen in einem internationalen Umfeld.

Dann freuen wir uns darauf dich kennenzulernen. Sende uns einfach deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen per E-Mail an: **karriere@asprova.eu** oder bewirb dich direkt über unsere Homepage: https://www.asprova.eu/offene-stellen/**.**

new_jobs.title: 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern - Germany
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Please note the role is available across multiple locations in Germany.  
  
Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
  
  
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
  
  
Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  
  
At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
  
  
We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
  
  
Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
  
  
Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation.
  
  
Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team.
  
  
Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.
  
  
Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
  
  
Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.
  
  
Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
  
  
Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.
  
  
Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
  
  
A day in the life  
As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  
  
In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.
  
  
About the team  
Intern Community:  
  
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.  
  
Support:  
  
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.  
  
Learning Sessions:  
  
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.  
  
Opportunities:  
  
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related STEM fields
* Experience with at least one general-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C++, C#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience from previous technical internship(s) or demonstrated project experience
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Strong problem decomposition, problem-solving, and analytical skills
* Demonstrated ownership and initiative in seeing work through from design to operation
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
m/w/d  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

new_jobs.title: Software Developer
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Progressive Building Society is a leading local financial institution with a proud reputation for customer service excellence. Our purpose is to encourage local people to save and become homeowners, through our personal, caring & common-sense approach, essentially nurturing financial well being for current and future generations.

The Society is continuing to modernise and improve through its operational resilience processes, strong customer experience including self-services capabilities, integration between platforms, automation of processes, supporting our community and caring about our environmental impact.

**What you will be doing**

Developing, supporting and continuously improving software solutions that enhance the Society’s systems and business processes, working under supervision as part of the IT team and in line with Progressive’s development standards, security controls and regulatory requirements.

The role contributes to the Society’s strategic plan by analysing requirements, building and integrating applications, and promoting best practices such as CI/CD and test-driven development to improve user experience, automation and operational efficiency.

**About The Role**

**The Software Developer will be required to:**

* Analyse business needs with stakeholders to gather requirements for new and existing projects.
* Work with the in-house subject matter experts and IT teams to support the business and improve automation of key processes.
* Develop and maintain .NET solutions (e.g., C#, ASP.NET Core, APIs and background services) or SaaS platform changes, in line with agreed architecture and the Society’s coding standards and to deliver improved customer experience.
* Implement best practices such as continuous integration, continuous delivery and test-driven development.
* Write and maintain automated tests (unit/integration) using appropriate .NET testing frameworks and support test execution within the CI pipeline.
* Use source control and follow branching, pull request and code review practices; address review feedback and share learning with the team.
* Support data-related development including SQL query writing, stored procedure changes where applicable, and safe use of ORM/data access patterns.
* Assist with troubleshooting and resolution of defects and incidents across development, test and production environments, under supervision, including root-cause analysis and fix validation.
* Produce clear technical documentation (e.g., configuration notes, support guides and release notes) to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.
* Support build and release processes for .NET applications (e.g., Azure DevOps pipelines), including deployment steps, environment configuration and post-release verification.
* Use AI-assisted development tools appropriately to support software design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge discovery, while applying professional judgement, security requirements and coding standards.
* Evaluate and validate outputs generated by AI tools to ensure accuracy, maintainability, security and compliance with the Society's policies and regulatory obligations.
* Contribute to the adoption of emerging development practices, including responsible use of AI technologies to improve team productivity and software quality.

  *Progressive Building Society is committed to providing equal opportunities for all. As part of our recruitment process, successful applicants will be subject to our pre-employment checks. These include credit checks and criminal record checks (Access NI basic check through a responsible body).*

**Required Criteria**

* Degree in Computer Science related discipline.
* A minimum of one year’s experience developing applications in a professional work environment.
* Experience of .NET ecosystem and C#.
* Awareness of programming best practices and ability to apply them under guidance
* Good understanding of current and emerging technologies and their potential to deliver business benefits.
* Good analytical approach to problem solving.
* API integration to core platforms (e.g. banking systems).
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to adapt style and explanations to support others’ understanding.
* Understanding of AI-assisted software development tools and the ability to apply them effectively to support coding, testing, debugging, documentation and problem solving.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure solutions meet security, quality and business requirements.

**Desired Criteria**

* A scripting language, such as Python or Powershell.
* Development and design skills with MS SQL or Oracle.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or similar technologies.

**About The Company**

Careers at Progressive

We know that looking for a career means so much more than just finding a job. At Progressive, we want to help you find your happy place to work.

We firmly believe in encouraging our employees to achieve the right balance between their work and personal lives, delivering access to and promoting family-friendly policies.

This not only increases employee satisfaction but also enables Progressive to meet the needs of our Members and supports the Society in being positioned as one of the most successful financial institutions in Northern Ireland.

**Company Culture**

To work for Progressive is to be part of something special. We strive to nurture and develop our employees in the evolving and fast paced financial services industry. Outlined below are a list of the reasons why we feel Progressive is a great place to work:

We aim to provide an inclusive and respectful working environment, where everyone recognises the importance and impact of teamwork.

We celebrate staff diversity and work hard to ensure that our staff members feel valued as individuals and respected for their contribution to our success.

We offer opportunities for our staff to work at the heart of our communities and make real differences to our Members’ lives.

We do not subscribe to a long-hours culture, instead valuing family life and supporting our staff to balance work and family commitments.

**Company Benefits**

We offer our staff competitive employment conditions and a range of benefits designed to achieve high levels of staff engagement and job satisfaction.

We understand that by taking steps to positively enhance the well-being of our staff, we can help them to achieve their goals and boost their motivation to deliver the best possible outcomes for our members.

Vacation, Paid time off, Performance bonuses, Paid sick days, Retirement plan and/or pension, Employee development programs, Tuition reimbursement, Open office, Competitive salary, Life insurance, Long service recognition, Employee Assistance Scheme, Wellbeing Scheme, Work With Charities, Social Opportunities, Annual Rise

**Salary**

Not disclosed

new_jobs.title: Senior Principal Mechanical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Today, Assystem is among the top three independent nuclear engineering firms worldwide. With over 60 years of experience in highly regulated sectors, the group supports public and industrial stakeholders in the execution of complex and strategic infrastructure projects, subject to high safety and security requirements.

Assystem mobilizes 8,000 experts in 13 countries and intervenes across the entire project lifecycle, in engineering, project management and digital solutions.

 **Job Description**

**Join the Fusion and Modular Nuclear Business Unit!** Assystem has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Principal MechanicalEngineer to join our expanding Fusion and Modular Nuclear (FMN) business unit. As leaders in the design and development of new technologies, you will have the opportunity to work across multiple cutting-edge projectsdeveloping technical solutions making net-zero power generation a reality.

**Your mission:**

* Lead and support the development of designs for the following systems:
* Personnel Airlocks, Main Equipment Access Hatch, Fuel Transfer Channel, Piping Penetrations, Electrical Penetrations, Specialist Nuclear Doors
* Conduct DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) to identify and mitigate potential failure modes early in the design process.
* Perform HAZID (Hazard Identification Study) to assess and document risks across the system.
* Complete and maintain Human Factors Checklists to ensure ergonomics and usability are considered in design decisions.
* Update and manage the project’s Risk Register to track, evaluate, and mitigate emerging risks.
* Design Package Production in Line with Requirements – Oversee the creation of comprehensive design packages, ensuring alignment with project specifications, technical standards, and operational needs.
* Management of Interfaces – Coordinate effectively between engineering teams, suppliers, and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration of cooling water systems with other reactor components.
* Preparation of Technical Specifications – Develop clear, detailed technical specifications to guide procurement, fabrication, and installation of key cooling water system components.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including both new and existing FTEs and secondees across engineering and project functions.

**Why Join the Community of Switchers?**

* Over 55 years in nuclear engineering.
* Ranked among the top 3 largest nuclear engineering companies.
* Attractive social benefits, including an engaging Employee Committee and holiday bonuses.
* Ongoing training with numerous career opportunities.
* 70% of our managers are promoted internally!
* Hybrid work: 1-2 days remote per week.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Multi-Disciplinary Team Leadership – Skilled in managing and coordinating diverse engineering teams.
* Steam Cycle Modelling Oversight – Ability to define modelling outcomes and ensure accurate implementation.
* Project Budget & Lifecycle Planning – Experienced in budgeting and planning for full design lifecycles.
* Cooling Water Equipment Expertise – Strong track record in designing and optimizing cooling water systems.
* Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge – Well-versed in ONR, Environment Agency, and HSE regulations.
* Requirements Capture Experience – Skilled in gathering and defining technical requirements.
* Systems Engineering Awareness – Strong understanding of integrated design principles.
* Subcontractor Management – Experienced in overseeing and coordinating subcontractors.
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) – Professional accreditation in a relevant discipline.
* Security Clearance Eligibility – Capable of obtaining SC clearance for secure projects.

  
**Additional Information**  

* Excellent communication skills, written and oral
* Strong leadership skills
* Focus on delivering quality output to time and budget
* Act with integrity and instils this in others
* Has an appreciation of wider technical issues beyond own discipline – Understands interdisciplinary challenges and their impact on projects.
* Ability to work with a high degree of independence, using their own initiative and self-motivation – Proactive and capable of managing tasks autonomously.
* Confident in a multi-party, multi-national environment – Comfortable working with global teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to travel to Assystem offices and customer sites within the UK
* To undertake work packages supporting major UK and international Nuclear Clients – Contributes to high-profile nuclear projects with global impact.

**Due to the nature of work to be undertaken applicants will be required to meet certain residency criteria in order to attain a minimum level of UK security clearance if not already security cleared to a minimum SC level.**

**NOTICE TO CANDIDATES ON RECRUITMENT FRAUD - We are committed to safeguarding candidates from fraudulent activity associated with our recruitment process. Please note that we will never offer specialist CV writing services, request payment or ask for sensitive personal information during the recruitment process.**

We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

new_jobs.title: AI & Software Development Apprentice
new_jobs.description:
**Hands-On AI & Software Development Apprentice**

**Full-time apprenticeship | Northampton | On site**

**Cybist has an exceptional opportunity for a bright, creative and ambitious aspiring software developer to take steps towards turning a passion for AI into a career, in a real world practical environment helping build intelligent applications and integrations that make a real difference to a growing business.**

**About Cybist**

We are a rapidly growing **eco tech business**, giving high-quality computers and IT equipment a second life, reducing electronic waste and making technology more accessible. Visit cybist.com or visit our Amazon webstore.

Our small, friendly, professional team has big ambitions. We are rapidly integrating AI into our software and business systems, developing tools for product identification, listing creation, app integration and commercial decision-making.

Our commitment to creating opportunities for young people has been recognised with a Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) Kickstart award. We are also engaging with Amazon’s US team on advanced listing and multichannel selling tools, contributing practical feedback from our own development and commercial experience.

You will learn how AI and software can support our work streams - and you will be hands-on and carry out work with the hardware itself, equipment and processes.

As your skills develop, the role can evolve around your strengths, interests and the needs of the business.

**What you will work on**

* Building and testing AI-assisted applications for real business use.
* Connecting apps and services through APIs and tools such as Zapier, Make and n8n.
* Developing software that supports product listings, ecommerce and our internal operational systems.
* Supporting practical production and stock workflows, using our mobile app to capture product information and photographs, and helping organise equipment in the correct stock areas.
* Working with code, databases and AI tools to solve practical problems.
* Exploring new ideas and helping turn the best ones into reliable, useful applications.

**Who we are looking for**

Someone with a fantastic enthusiasm for AI and software, strong technical curiosity and an ability to solve problems and the determination to work things out. Someone not afraid to work hard and to put in what it takes to achieve success.

You should already be experimenting with coding, AI tools or automation. Personal projects, college work, a useful script, an app integration or something you have built for fun can all demonstrate your potential.

Familiarity with coding would be useful, whether in Python, JavaScript or another language. We also value creativity, clear thinking, attention to detail and the ability to work well with others. Our current system being developed is PostgressSQL/.NET/React and Tailwind using ChatGPT Pro/Codex.

**What you will gain**

* Structured apprenticeship training, a recognised qualification and paid time for learning.
* Practical support and mentoring within a small team.
* Experience developing software and AI integrations used in a real business.
* The chance to contribute ideas and take increasing responsibility as your skills grow.
* A foundation for a career in software development, AI and automation.

**How to apply**

To help your application stand out, please send your CV with a short cover letter explaining:

* Why this opportunity interests you.
* Why you think you would be especially good at it, including examples of anything you have built or explored.
* When you would be available to come in, meet the team and attend an interview.

**HVDC Converter Station Engineer**
===================================

### **About the role**

Are you an ambitious electrical engineer looking to work on some of the most innovative energy infrastructure projects in Europe?

At **National Grid Ventures (NGV)**, we're delivering the next generation of interconnectors and offshore hybrid assets that will help connect renewable energy, strengthen energy security and support the transition to net zero. As an **HVDC Converter Station Engineer**, you'll play a key role in shaping the technology at the heart of these projects, including **LionLink** – a pioneering development connecting the UK to offshore wind generation in the Netherlands and onward to the Dutch onshore grid.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop specialist expertise in **High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC)** technology while working alongside industry-leading engineers, international partners and global technology suppliers.

### **What you'll do**

As a Converter Station Engineer, you'll support the design, development and delivery of HVDC converter station systems across major strategic projects. You'll gain exposure to real engineering challenges and play a key part in ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest technical standards.

Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the development and assurance of converter station requirements from concept through to delivery.
* Providing technical support during the Development Consent Order (DCO) process, including the preparation of responses to technical queries.
* Working with OEMs, consultants and project partners to demonstrate compliance with GB Grid Code requirements, National Grid standards and project specifications.
* Reviewing designs, studies, reports and technical proposals, helping to resolve engineering challenges throughout project delivery.
* Supporting critical interfaces across converter technology, grid connection, cable, civil, control and wider project teams.
* Participating in design reviews, factory acceptance testing, site testing and commissioning activities.
* Supporting the integration of protection and control systems, communications, auxiliary systems and third-party interfaces.
* Contributing technical expertise to tender evaluations and future technology selections.

### **What you'll need**

We're looking for engineers who are curious, collaborative and excited by the opportunity to develop expertise in a specialist area that is central to the energy transition.

You'll ideally have:

* A degree, or equivalent experience, in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, HVDC, Control Systems, Substations or a related discipline.
* A genuine interest in power transmission, renewable energy integration or major infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of HVDC technology, converter stations, substations, electrical systems or protection and control systems (desirable but not essential).
* The ability to analyse technical information and communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to learning.
* A collaborative mindset and the confidence to contribute within a supportive engineering team.

### **What you'll get**

A competitive salary between £54,000 - £63,000 per annum– dependent on capability.

As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

###

**This role closes on Tuesday 20th October at 23:59**, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.

We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates – we make appointments purely on merit, assessed against objective selection criteria. We support flexible working and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process should you have any physical or mental impairment which may affect your ability to participate in the process.

Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

new_jobs.title: Commercial Solar PV Design Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Join Us**

Bord Gáis Energy has been powering the nation’s homes and businesses for 50 years. Today we are evolving from a utility supplier to a total energy solutions provider – combining trusted gas and electricity expertise with a growing portfolio of net zero products and services. We are at the forefront of Ireland’s energy transition strengthening energy security and helping customers moves to a low carbon future. Ardrar Ltd, recently acquired by Bord Gáis Energy (part of Centrica plc), is scaling rapidly as a leading provider of solar solutions across Ireland.

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth business, leveraging the strength of an established and trusted brand, Bord Gáis Energy, in the Irish market, backed by an international energy group (Centrica Plc).

**Your Team (Ardrar Ltd – A Bord Gáis Energy Company)**

Ardrar Ltd, part of the Bord Gáis Energy family, is one of Ireland’s fastest-growing providers of smart, sustainable energy solutions. We combine the agility of a rapidly scaling, technology-led business with the strength and reach of an established brand and energy leader in the Irish market

**Employment Terms**

This role is employed by Ardrar Ltd, which operates under separate terms and conditions to Bord Gáis Energy. Together we’re helping homes, farms and businesses cut costs, reduce emissions, and transition to cleaner energy.

**The Role**

We are seeking a **Commercial Solar PV Design Engineer** to support the next phase of transformation as we accelerate our transition to a more sustainable energy future. This role is central to our technical delivery, responsible for designing optimised, compliant, and cost-effective solar PV systems for commercial, industrial, and agricultural customers across Ireland.

You will work closely with our sales, project management, and installation teams to translate customer requirements and site conditions into engineered solutions that maximise energy yield, meet grid connection requirements, and align with project budgets and timelines.

**Core Responsibilities**

*System Design & Engineering*

* Design and develop detailed solar PV proposals for rooftop and ground-mounted commercial solar PV systems (typically 50 kWp to 5 MWp).
* Conduct virtual and physical site assessments to evaluate solar resources, perform shading analysis, and determine optimal system configuration.
* Create detailed technical reports including module layouts, string configurations, and array designs that maximise energy production while respecting structural, electrical, and fire safety constraints.
* Prepare single-line diagrams (SLDs), three-line diagrams, panel layouts, wiring diagrams, and earthing/lightning protection designs.
* Perform DC and AC cable sizing, voltage drop calculations, and protection device coordination.
* Select and specify major equipment including PV modules, inverters, mounting structures, combiner boxes, and balance of system components.
* Use industry-standard software (PVsyst, Helioscope, or equivalent) to perform energy yield simulations and estimate system production.
* Conduct shading and loss analysis, incorporating weather data, soiling assumptions, degradation rates, and system performance ratios.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*

* Provide technical support to the commercial sales team during the tender and proposal stage, including design, yield estimates, and equipment specifications.
* Create detailed pricing files including full Bill of Materials (BOM) for each project.
* Liaise with suppliers to get up to date pricing for materials.
* Work closely with project managers to resolve design-related RFIs, review contractor submittals, and support construction-phase engineering.
* Collaborate with structural and civil engineers on racking, foundation, and roof loading assessments for complex installations.
* Provide technical guidance to installation and commissioning teams, troubleshooting design or construction issues in the field.

*Technical Documentation & Compliance*

* Prepare engineering deliverables including stamped drawings, design specifications, equipment submittal and as-built drawings.
* Ensure all designs comply with Irish and EU standards, building regulations, ESB Networks grid connection requirements, and SEAI grant specifications.
* Support pre-install team by preparing technical documentation for ESB Networks and local authority planning submissions.

**Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering, Civil/Structural Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent relevant industry experience).
* Minimum 2–4 years' experience in commercial or utility-scale solar PV system design.
* Proficiency in solar design software such as PVsyst, Helioscope, Opensolar or equivalent.
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD or similar CAD software for producing construction-ready drawings.
* Solid understanding of solar PV technology, electrical systems, and grid interconnection requirements.
* Knowledge of Irish and EU electrical standards, building regulations, and ESB Networks grid connection processes.
* Experience preparing single-line diagrams, cable sizing calculations, and Bills of Materials.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Full clean driver's license (some site visits required).

**Why should you apply?**

This is your chance to shape Ireland’s clean energy future. You’ll work in a fast-growing business, collaborate with top talent, and accelerate your development every step of the way. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth business with the backing of a national energy leader with a trusted heritage brand, Bord Gáis Energy is part of Centrica plc, a leading international energy and services company. Benefit from the scale, investment, and expertise of the Bord Gáis Energy / Centrica Group.

Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: €55,000.00-€65,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Relevant: 1 year (required)

new_jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **Program Overview**

RDG (Risk Decision Group) provides nationwide background investigations compliant with national government standards to include support of continuous vetting for over 110 government agencies.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is seeking an experienced **AWS Cloud Security Engineer** to design, build, and operate security controls for a FedRAMP Moderate-authorized AWS cloud infrastructure supporting Peraton's RDG (Risk Decision Group) program. This is a hands-on role with a key part in day-to-day cloud security operations, embedding secure-by-design principles into cloud architecture, and maintaining continuous FedRAMP compliance.

The engineer is responsible for implementing security architecture, hardening cloud environments, maintaining continuous compliance monitoring, and supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience securing AWS environments within a federal compliance framework (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, RMF, or similar).

**This is a 100% remote position.**

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement security architecture for AWS workloads aligned with FedRAMP Moderate baseline controls
* Build and maintain security guardrails using AWS-native services (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF, Macie, Inspector)
* Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code security controls (Terraform/CloudFormation) with policy as code
* Support System Security Plans (SSPs), ATO activities, and POA&M remediation
* Perform continuous monitoring, vulnerability scanning, patch management tracking, and monthly/annual assessment support
* Configure and maintain centralized logging, SIEM integration, and audit trail retention per FedRAMP/NIST requirements
* Implement least-privilege IAM policies, service control policies (SCPs), and cross-account access controls.
* Manage encryption at rest and in transit (KMS, ACM, TLS enforcement) per FIPS 140-2/140-3 requirements where applicable
* Respond to security incidents, perform root cause analysis, and support cloud-specific incident response playbooks
* Collaborate with DevOps/Platform teams to embed security into CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps)
* Maintain documentation for control implementation statements, architecture diagrams, and audit evidence
* Support boundary definition and system categorization activities (FIPS 199) as required

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* US citizenship required; ability to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret eligible clearance
* Minimum 8 years work experience with BS/BA in computer science, or 10 years work experience with an AA/AS degree in Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5+ years of hands-on AWS engineering experience, with 3+ years specifically in cloud security roles
* Demonstrated experience working within a FedRAMP Moderate or FedRAMP High, DoD IL4/IL5, or equivalent federal compliance environment
* Experience supporting or maintaining an SSP and RMF processes
* Experience with AWS GovCloud (US), AWS Commercial, or equivalent federal AWS environments
* Strong hands-on expertise with AWS security services: IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF, Macie, Inspector, and Systems Manager
* Solid understanding of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control families (AC, AU, CM, IA, SC, SI, etc.) and the ability to map implementations to specific controls
* 3+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation), including security scanning and policy-as-code tools
* Networking security fundamentals: VPC design, security groups, NACLs, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, and network segmentation for compliance boundaries
* Experience with vulnerability management tools (AWS Inspector or similar) and remediation tracking
* Experience implementing Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) in AWS
* Familiarity with SIEM/log aggregation tools (Splunk, AWS CloudWatch, OpenSearch, or similar) for security event monitoring
* Scripting ability in Python or Bash for automating compliance checks and remediation
* Understanding of encryption standards relevant to federal systems (FIPS 140-2/140-3, TLS 1.2+)
* One of the following certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (with a security focus), or CISSP, CISM, or Security+ (with strong AWS hands-on experience).

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Direct experience supporting a Peraton program or similar federal integrator (Leidos, Booz Allen, SAIC, General Dynamics IT, etc.)
* Familiarity with server and systems hardening software
* Experience with container security (ECS/EKS), including image scanning (ECR scanning) and runtime protection
* Experience with AWS Control Tower and multi-account landing zone security governance
* Experience automating compliance evidence collection for continuous ATO (cATO)
* Prior experience with change management processes in a regulated/audited environment
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field
* Active security clearance
* Experience with AWS AI services (Amazon Bedrock)
* Experience with hybrid/multi-cloud architecture, including Azure (VNets, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure Policy, ExpressRoute)
* Experience with Microsoft .NET
* Experience supporting ATO/continuous monitoring processes
* Familiarity with DevSecOps pipelines
* Familiarity with AI security and governance frameworks, national security/defense/critical infrastructure missions, and supporting federal agencies or large GovCon programs

#RDG

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely.
  
  
In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data.
  
  
What you will do
  
Maintain Performance
  

* Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance.

  
Debug and Test
  

* Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running.

  
Develop for the Future
  

* Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services.

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience
  
  

* Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects.
* Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software.
* Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services.
* Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues.
* Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns.

  
Preferred skills and experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl.
* Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

new_jobs.title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Buyer Safety Experience
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

“WARNING: Choking Hazard — small parts. Not for children under 3 years.”  
  
“WARNING: This product can expose you to chemicals including antimony trioxide, which are known to cause cancer or birth defects or other reproductive harm.”  
  
Have you ever seen these warning labels on popular and seemingly innocent products, such as fidget spinners or food containers? As the Buyer Safety Experience team for Amazon Retail worldwide, we aim to raise the bar when it comes to educating and empowering consumers about product safety. Our team is responsible for the complete end-to-end safety experience for buyers — from the warnings you see on the product detail pages (and how to turn them into useful, actionable information), to making safer product recommendations targeted to each individual consumer’s needs, to informing consumers of recalled products and preventing them from being delivered to their doorstep.  
  
As the founding engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience - Romania team, you’ll be able to build the groundwork and influence its direction for the years to come. Our work cuts across various disciplines — from delivering an awesome customer and brand experience via great UI/UX, to building massively scalable distributed systems to support the most high-traffic pages on Amazon worldwide, to analytical and feedback systems which give us data-driven customer insights, to using GenAI to enable Selling Partners and brands to keep customers safe and informed. If you have a passion for both consumer and business-facing applications, and are obsessed with customer experience, we want you!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
As the first Software Development Engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience team in Romania, you will hire and lead a brand new team, and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders worldwide across Program and Product. Your role will be heavily customer-obsessed, building solutions to ensure Amazon is Earth's safest place to shop.  
  
A day in the life  

* Hiring: Build a new team from scratch
* Deeply understand technical decisions, influence long-term architecture
* Define the team's yearly goals and long-term technical vision and charter, along with product and business stakeholders
* Work closely with international stakeholders across our VP-level Trustworthy Shopping Experience org, in addition to TPM and PM-T

  
Key job responsibilities  
As the first Software Development Engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience team in RO, you will hire and lead a new team, and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders worldwide across Program and Product. Your role will be heavily customer-obsessed, building solutions to ensure Amazon is Earth's safest place to shop.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
* Experience in development in the last 3 years

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

* **Introduction:** A position as EME System Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space in Getafe (Madrid).

* **Brief description of the department’s mission** :

  

The selected candidate will join the TADYX1 Team in charge of managing the disciplines of electromagnetic protection for aircraft structures and systems and antenna integration.

The candidate will be part of multicultural and multidisciplinary team working in different military programs under our product portfolio, reinforcing the team in or der to ensure the implementation of complex design solutions within different challenging military projects, covering all the complete development V cycle: from customer/airworthiness requirements capture to aircraft certification, aircraft delivery and in-service aircraft support.

**SKILLS**

  

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:

  

*-* **Education:**

Degree in Telecommunication Engineering, Aeronautical, Electrical Engineering or Physics

* **Experience:**

At least 5 years in Engineering with strong background in electromagnetism theory, electromagnetic protection measures applied to aircraft structures and systems/equipment and aircraft design.

Knowledge about integration at platform level (complete cycle: specification, validation, verification, certification/qualification).

User of complex and advanced tools for electromagnetic simulation and modelling for EME design and antenna integration (CST, FEKO, etc,..). CAD management, computational tools and postprocessing.

Good Technical skills, familiar with R/T and R&D projects.

Ability to work autonomously as well as being active part of a team.

Ability to overcome difficulties in the development of the projects.

Knowledge of applicable standard and regulation for EME equipment qualification and aircraft certification (e.g. DO-160, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, CS/FAR25, etc,…).

* **Soft skills** : High adaptability to work on new topics, new business and in a networking mode.

*-* **Languages:** Advanced level in English.

*-* **Technical knowledge** : programming in C#, advanced level of CATIA, Matlab, …

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:

* Vacation days and additional days-off along the year (+35 days off in total)
* Attractive salary and compensation package

* Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment
Special rates in products & benefits

new_jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

IT systems that work effectively keep Amazon’s operations running at full speed. Our IT Support Engineers work behind the scenes to troubleshoot any issues and improve our systems, so that we can operate at our best. Your focus will be to make sure our IT infrastructure is up to the demands of our global business. At the same time, you’ll get to work with the latest technology and learn from leaders who are creating the warehouse environments of the future.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Support end-user equipment and your building’s IT infrastructure
* Help with key network projects, like the IT setup of new Amazon buildings
* Suggest new processes that improve the way Amazon uses IT in its operational sites
* Train and mentor IT technicians

  
A day in the life  
You’ll be based on site and will travel to other operational sites in your country, and potentially internationally, several times a month. As an IT Support Engineer, you’ll work with remote and on-site colleagues to support them with any issues. You’ll use your expertise to make sure our platforms are working at their best, often implementing projects to maintain or improve our IT infrastructure. In some cases, you may also help design the infrastructure for new buildings and make sure everything is working for the site launch.  
  
About the team  
Ops Tech Solutions (OTS) is the field IT organization responsible for first level troubleshoot of IT issues in our FCs, distribution centers and other sites.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis
* Experience working in complex IT environments or equivalent
* Knowledge of IP networking fundamentals and extensive experience in the application of IP protocols
* Experience in network and operating system support
* Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish and English at C1 level or above
* Valid EU driver's license

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing operations environment
* Experience working in a customer-facing environment
* Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment
* certification in an applicable field like A+, Net+, Sec+, CCNA, LPIC, Linux+, AWS certification
* Experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP, or experience in software development and experience in managing and troublshooting network

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
